title: Planning & Performance
description:
**Job Title:**
Planning & Performance
  
  
**Department**
: PI Germany
  
  
**About Business line/Function:**
CIO Office
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
The mission of Planning & Performance is to ensure a smooth flow of information between the stakeholders of its field and controlling, making transparency in all key figures for the stakeholders involved and thus bringing financial and functional needs in consistent.
  
  
The person acts as a strategic partner of IT management and supports operational as well as strategic corporate management. It ensures transparency in financial performance, identifies potential for improvement and actively contributes to achieving the company's goals. Plus, it combines financial expertise with business management understanding and high consulting competence towards the specialist departments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* The Planning & Performance ensures the planning process based on the budget and the forecasts for its department and implements it as an interface between Controlling and department.
* Economic calculations, price calculations, benchmark evaluations, data and statistical analyses plus ad hoc requests for reports are prepared, for example in the framework of the development of business cases.
* Candidate prepares the financial planning data for management and the department, communicates these and develops the cost planning with them.
* The results can be prepared in a way that is tailored to the needs and recipients for the specific presentations.
* Deviations between target and actual values within the framework of forecasting/planning shall be analyzed and commented on for the area of responsibility and inconsistencies shall be resolved.
* Ongoing control and ensuring cost control as well as data transparency, in particular regarding correct accounting of individual bookings in cooperation with Accounting.
* The KPIs for measuring performance are continuously developed further with the involvement of all relevant decision-makers.
* The use of resources for the provision of all services shall be controlled and advised upon in its selection.
* The functional and budgetary requirements are made consistent with each other.
* The financial optimization of the department shall be ensured in cooperation with the stakeholders.
* The area also ensures a continuous development of its processes and reporting structures.

**Contributing Responsibilities**

* The Planning & Performance is the first point of contact for Business Controlling and ensures with it the fulfillment of the controlling tasks in its field of expertise.
* Candidate works closely with the cost center managers of his department incl. n-managers and business managers to make planning & performance transparent and to help stakeholders in decision-making from a financial perspective.
* Candidate contributes to a continuous enrichment of knowledge of his stakeholders and advises the various teams with best practices and tools.
* Further important interfaces are Accounting as well as Tribe Data plus the Sourcing Hub.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Completed degree (e.g. economics, computer science, mathematics or comparable quantitative studies) and many years of subject-specific professional experience (e.g. controlling / performance management).
* Alternatively completed vocational training or completed training supplemented by additional certificates of expertise and long-term vocational experience.
* Expert knowledge in the required field.
* Detailed understanding of economic relationships within his field of expertise (market, IT, operations etc), ideally in an international environment.
* Very good analytical conceptual skills and ways of thinking as well as interest in complex, (un)structured data sets and high affinity to technical processes.
* Independent, structured and results-oriented working method, resilience as well as organizational skill and conscientiousness (routine handling of several inquiries in parallel).

**Specific Qualifications**

* Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office, expert knowledge of Excel, as well as experience with SAP CO/FI, IBM Cognos TM1 / Spotfire.
* Fluent German and very good English skills in speaking and writing.
* Knowledge of IT systems and data architecture respectively ability to quickly acquire these skills.
* At least 5 years of Exp in Finance planning

**Technical Skills**




+ Ability to collaborate / Teamwork
+ Client focused
+ Attention to detail / rigor
+ Ability to deliver / Results driven

**Behavioral Skills**




+ Ability to develop others & improve their skills
+ Ability to understand, explain and support change

**Education Level:**
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.

At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. title: Senior Associate/Analyst – Group Financial Consolidation & Reporting
description:
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a finance professional to manage Group Consolidation reporting and support Corporate Finance in ensuring accurate, standardized, and timely financial reporting across multiple legal entities and geographies, in accordance with IFRS.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Prepare Group Consolidation Reporting (Monthly/Quarterly & Annual) in accordance with IFRS, including Balance Sheet, P&L, Cash Flow, Segmental Reporting, and Notes to Accounts
* Consolidate financials of 150+ legal entities across different geographies and multiple currencies, including revaluation and translation
* Conduct peer benchmarking and analysis on key KPIs
* Prepare comparative analysis of key P&L and Balance Sheet schedules for review by CFO/CEO
* Manage and coordinate Month End, Quarterly, and Year End reporting timelines
* Handle Group Audit coordination with Group Statutory Auditors
* Conduct analytics through S&P Capital IQ
* Coordinate with Country Finance Teams and Corporate Office to ensure timely, accurate reporting
* Review Monthly/Quarterly MIS and legal entity-wise financials; drive standardization and compliance with Group Accounting Policy
* Liaise with Country Finance Controllers/Regional Finance Controllers on accounting, reporting, and disclosure matters
* Review journal and group adjustment entries to ensure group eliminations, IFRS compliance, and reporting accuracy
* Coordinate with Internal IT, SAP, and BPC teams on MIS and consolidation system issues
* Support automation of Group reporting through BPC and implementation of new systems/reports

**Qualifications**

* Semi-Qualified Inter CA, Inter ICWA, or MBA Finance from a reputed institute (Qualified CA preferred but not mandatory)
* 3-4 years of relevant experience in Group Consolidation/Financial Reporting
* Sound understanding of IFRS or Ind AS
* Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret and generate financial data, reports, and statements
* Experience with consolidation system implementation; knowledge of SAP and SAP Consolidation (BPC) desirable; experience with alternate consolidation software (e.g., Hyperion) also acceptable
* Expert knowledge of MS Excel

**Candidate Profile**

* Good communication skills
* Ability to work independently with a high degree of self-initiative
* Willingness to travel for Quarterly and Year-End finalization to corporate office and/or select geographies
* Based in Chennai or willing to relocate; should be close to office location or willing to commute daily

Skills: sap bpc,multi-entity/multi-currency reporting,ifrs reporting,group financial consolidation,corporate finance

title: Finance Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Shilton Hospitality Pvt Ltd is a diversified hospitality company operating business hotels, resto-bars, catering services, music festivals, and leisure resorts. The organization focuses on delivering memorable guest experiences across both corporate and recreational segments. With a mix of accommodation, dining, events, and entertainment offerings, Shilton Hospitality emphasizes quality service and operational excellence. The company provides a dynamic environment for professionals interested in hospitality, finance, and business operations. Team members have the opportunity to contribute to a growing portfolio and engage with multiple hospitality formats.
  
**Role Description**
The Finance Executive role at Shilton Hospitality Pvt Ltd is a full-time, on-site position based in Chennai. The role involves managing day-to-day financial operations, including preparation, review, and reconciliation of financial statements. * Candidates should possess working knowledge of Goods and Services Tax (GST) and related compliance requirements.
* Candidates should possess robust Analytical Skills for cost monitoring, variance analysis, and data-driven decision support.
* Relevant academic background such as a degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting/ERP software commonly used in finance and hospitality.
* Strong attention to detail, integrity in handling financial data, and ability to meet deadlines.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with operations, management, and external stakeholders.
* Prior experience in hospitality or multi-unit business environments is an advantage.

title: AVP-Risk (Credit & Cpty) and Performance Manager
description:
**Job Title: Assistant Vice President**
**Department: 2S Operations**
**About Business Line/Function**
**The Strategic Business Development and Transformation (SBDT) Team**
The SBDT team defines the regional go-to-market strategy and value proposition across all products and locations. The team manages the product portfolio, designs client solutions, and leads transformational initiatives across multiple product and solution domains. This function aligns the business with market, regulatory, and client requirements to drive optimal client satisfaction.
  
  
The SBDT team comprises several specialized units: Product and Solutions, Strategy and Business Management, Business Credit Advisors (BCA), Regulatory Watch.
  
  
To deliver strategic outcomes, the department collaborates closely with key internal stakeholders. Primary partners include the client coverage teams (Sales, Relationship Management, and Client Service) and the Service and IT delivery leadership (Client Delivery). Furthermore, the team maintains close working relationships with FIC, Global Markets, BNP Paribas Asset Management, and Wealth Management.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
**As the Securities Services (2S) footprint expands across the APAC region, the division is increasingly recognized as an industry leader. To support the growing franchise, we are seeking talented professionals to support the following functions:**

* Risk management – Business credit analyst (BCA) CIB2S BCA team is a team of experts in credit risk in post trade services of CIB2S. As experts, the team provides risk assessments for these activities to CIB2S Business, Credit analysts and RISK credit delegation holders in the context of credit requests and annual credit reviews. The team members also contribute to raising risk awareness across CIB2S. The team collaborates with all CIB2S locations, engaging with various business lines and functions across the organization.
* Performance Management Framework - The team oversees the following areas:

**Business Management**
: Managing governance and P&L monitoring, while contributing to strategic product development initiatives for APAC Client Lines.
  
  
**Strategic Leadership:**
Driving strategic initiatives, including business, location, and regional strategies, alongside comprehensive market reviews for CIB2S.
  
  
**Policy Alignment:**
Collaborating with Head Office to implement 2S policies and procedures affecting APAC SBDT.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  
**Risk Management**

* Credit Assessment: Review credit requests prepared by Coverage and Front Office teams, providing critical challenge when proposed activity structures or risk mitigants deviate from BNP Paribas Credit Policies.
* Limit Calibration: Calibrate requested credit limits to ensure alignment with risk appetite.
* Risk Advisory: Provide formal risk opinions to Credit Analysts and Credit Officers regarding specific requests.
* Committee Representation: Represent the Business in credit committees, working in partnership with Client Development.
* Governance & Compliance: Manage post-committee follow-ups with relevant stakeholders to ensure all pending conditions are met.
* Due Diligence: Participate in client due diligence processes as required.
* Legal Risk Analysis: Analyze the credit risk implications of amendments to legal agreements and provide strategic recommendations to decision-makers.
* Strategic Projects: Contribute to projects concerning CIB2S credit risk topics and portfolio analysis.
* Market Intelligence: Maintain proactive awareness of evolving CIB2S activities, regulatory environments and credit risk methodologies, disseminating key insights to Management and business partners.
* Country Risk Monitoring: Utilize existing framework (e.g., country envelopes) and develop enhanced methodologies for the holistic monitoring of risk exposures in sensitive jurisdictions.
* Product Development: Advise CIB2S Product teams on potential risk impacts during the product development lifecycle.

**Performance Management**

* Governance Support: supporting APAC Client Lines Executive Committee (Exco) governance through the preparation of decision-making analyses across a broad range of strategic topics.
* Strategic Initiatives: supporting regional strategic initiatives, including business, location, and regional strategies, market reviews, and market share analyses.
* Financial Management: Supporting Client Lines' financial reporting, headcount planning, cost management, and the budgeting process, alongside reviewing allocation keys and producing regional newsletters and dashboards.
* Profitability Optimization: Supporting initiatives to improve profitability for key regional clients and proposing actionable plans to enhance client and product margins.
* Committee Management: Assisting senior management committees, including the Client Line Board, APAC Business Committees, and Client Line Steering Committees—by preparing strategic documentation and action plans.
* Product Development: Contributions towards various regional product development initiatives.
* Stakeholder Liaison: Liaising with Head Office on SBDT-related matters as required.
* Ad Hoc Projects: Executing ad hoc tasks within the performance management remit.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Proven expertise in credit or counterparty risk management within a financial institution or risk consultancy.
* Deep understanding of the Securities Services industry, its product suite, and the complexities of various financial instruments and their associated risks.
* Advanced analytical and presentation skills, with high proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, and the ability to manipulate large, complex datasets with rigor.
* Ability in strategic planning and business management, underpinned by strong, independent problem-solving skills.
* Exceptional ability to synthesize complex information and formulate concise, high-impact messages for stakeholders.
* Ability to navigate complex organizational hierarchies and engage confidently with senior leadership
* Strong interpersonal skills with a proven ability to work collaboratively within a team.

**Education Level:**
Bachelor’s degree or above
  
  
**Specific Qualifications:**
CA or FRM or CFA qualification is highly desirable.
  
  
**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**




+ Credit & Cpty risk management and methodologies
+ Financial instruments and Risks
+ Proficiency in Power BI and familiarity with Design Thinking methodologies
+ Practical knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications

**Behavioral Skills**




+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills
+ Ability to interact with senior management
+ Business storytelling
+ Project Management

title: DWET - Manager - Project Planning, Billing
description:
The Manager - Project Planning, Billing & Project Controls is responsible for developing, monitoring, and controlling project schedules, budgets, billing activities, cost performance, and project reporting. The role ensures timely project execution, effective contract administration, cost optimization, and compliance with client and organizational requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Planning & Scheduling**

* Develop and maintain detailed project schedules using Primavera P6 and other planning tools.
* Prepare baseline schedules, resource plans, and project milestones.
* Monitor project progress and identify schedule variances.
* Generate recovery plans and mitigation strategies for delays.
* Coordinate with site, engineering, procurement, and construction teams to achieve project targets.

**Project Controls & Cost Management**

* Prepare project budgets and cost performance baselines.
* Monitor project expenditures against approved budgets.
* Conduct cost forecasting, variance analysis, and trend analysis.
* Implement Earned Value Management (EVM) techniques for performance measurement.
* Prepare monthly cost reports and management dashboards.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and improve project profitability.

**Billing Management**

* Prepare and process client RA bills and milestone-based invoices.
* Verify subcontractor bills and payment certifications.
* Coordinate with finance and commercial teams for timely collections.
* Monitor billing status and cash flow requirements.
* Reconcile quantities, measurements, and billing records.

**Contract Administration**

* Review contract conditions and ensure contractual compliance.
* Evaluate change orders, variations, and claims.
* Maintain records of contractual correspondence.
* Support dispute resolution and commercial negotiations.
* Ensure proper documentation for claims and extensions of time.

**Budget & Cash Flow Control**

* Develop project cash flow forecasts.
* Track actual cash flow versus planned cash flow.
* Monitor commitments and outstanding liabilities.
* Ensure optimum utilization of project resources.

**Reporting & Analysis**

* Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports.
* Generate productivity and performance analyses.
* Present project status updates to senior management.
* Monitor project KPIs and recommend corrective actions.
* Maintain project control databases and documentation.

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders.
* Conduct progress review meetings.
* Support project management in strategic decision-making.
* Facilitate communication among multidisciplinary teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Civil, Mechanical, or related Engineering discipline.
* PMP, Certified Cost Engineer (CCE), or equivalent certification preferred.
* Training in Project Management, Contract Management, and Cost Engineering is advantageous.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in project planning, billing, project controls, cost engineering, or quantity surveying.
* Experience in infrastructure, water, wastewater, EPC, industrial, utility, or construction projects.
* Proven experience handling large-scale multi-disciplinary projects.

**Technical Skills**

* Primavera P6 Planning & Scheduling.
* Client and Subcontractor Billing.
* Project Costing and Budget Control.
* Cash Flow Management.
* Contract Administration.
* Earned Value Management (EVM).
* Quantity Surveying.
* Cost Forecasting and Variance Analysis.
* Risk Assessment and Cost Control.
* Project Performance Reporting.
* SAP and JD Edwards (JDE) ERP systems.
* Microsoft Office Suite.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management.
* Decision-making under schedule and budget constraints.
* Negotiation and contract management skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced project environment.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Schedule adherence.
* Cost variance performance.
* Billing and collection efficiency.
* Project cash flow accuracy.
* Reduction in cost overruns.
* Timely submission of reports.
* Contract compliance and claims management.
* Client satisfaction and project profitability.

title: Management Information Systems Manager
description:
**JOB TITILE : Deputy Manager/Manager - MIS**

1. Job Purpose

To lead the MIS, business intelligence, and advanced analytics function for the organisation's alcoholic beverages business, enabling data-driven decision-making across sales, distribution, manufacturing, supply chain, finance, and commercial operations. The incumbent will develop integrated management dashboards, analyse state-wise business performance, monitor sales and profitability, strengthen SAP-based reporting, and provide actionable insights to senior management. The role requires an understanding of the Indian alcobev industry, including state-specific excise regulations, distribution structures, depot operations, product portfolios, pricing, market dynamics, and sales performance measurement.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. PAN India Sales MIS & Performance Analytics

* Develop daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual sales MIS for all states and business units.
* Prepare state-wise, region-wise, depot-wise, distributor-wise, product-wise, brand-wise, and employee-wise dashboards.
* Monitor sales against targets across volume, value, cases, litres, product categories, brands, and sales channels, wherever applicable.
* Analyse performance across IMFL, beer, and other relevant alcoholic beverage categories based on the organisation's product portfolio.
* Track sales achievement, growth trends, target gaps, primary and secondary sales, and market penetration.
* Monitor Sales Executives, ASMs, RSMs, State Heads, and institutional sales teams against defined KPIs.
* Identify underperforming territories, depots, products, and teams; provide root-cause analysis and corrective recommendations.
* Establish a standardised PAN India reporting framework for consistent performance measurement.

B. Alcobev Commercial & Market Analytics

* Analyse brand-wise and SKU-wise sales, product mix, premiumisation, price segments, and contribution to business growth.
* Monitor market share where reliable market data is available and assess competitive positioning across states and territories.
* Analyse state-wise pricing structures, approved selling prices, price revisions, product profitability, and contribution margins with Finance.
* Evaluate premium, economy, high-volume, and newly launched products.
* Track outlet coverage, outlet productivity, distribution reach, product availability, and sales conversion where data is available.
* Analyse the impact of seasonality, festivals, tourism, local demand, regulatory changes, and market conditions on sales.
* Provide analytical inputs for brand strategy, state expansion, market development, and product portfolio optimisation.

C. SAP & Enterprise Reporting

* Demonstrate strong working knowledge of SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA and its application to sales, distribution, finance, inventory, and operational reporting.
* Work with relevant SAP modules, particularly SD (Sales and Distribution), FI/CO (Finance and Controlling), and MM (Materials Management), as applicable.
* Extract, reconcile, and analyse SAP data relating to sales orders, billing, dispatches, inventory, receivables, pricing, and financial performance.
* Integrate SAP data with Power BI, SQL-based reporting environments, and other business intelligence tools.
* Ensure consistency between SAP records, depot reports, sales MIS, finance reports, and management dashboards.
* Coordinate with IT and functional teams to resolve discrepancies, improve integration, and enhance reporting capabilities.
* Support SAP reporting improvements, master data governance, and automation of recurring management reports.

D. Depot, Distribution & Inventory Analytics

* Monitor depot-wise stock availability, inventory ageing, stock-outs, slow-moving products, and inventory turnover.
* Analyse production, dispatches, stock transfers, sales, and closing inventory to identify supply-demand mismatches.
* Track order fulfilment, dispatch efficiency, depot throughput, and service levels across locations.
* Identify products and locations experiencing repeated stock shortages or excess inventory.
* Support production and supply chain planning through demand forecasts and historical sales analysis.
* Analyse distributor and channel performance, where applicable, to identify distribution bottlenecks and improve product availability.
* Develop exception reports for stock discrepancies, delayed dispatches, unusual sales movements, and inventory risks.

E. State-wise Excise & Regulatory Analytics

* Develop structured MIS to track state-wise excise-related commercial data, licence-linked business requirements, approved price lists, product registrations, and regulatory reporting timelines, as applicable.
* Monitor state-specific pricing approvals, product and label registration status, permitted product portfolios, and changes affecting commercial operations.
* Coordinate with State Sales, Excise, Finance, and Compliance teams to consolidate accurate and timely regulatory and business information.
* Develop dashboards for state-wise business restrictions, approval dependencies, regulatory changes, and their potential impact on sales and distribution.
* Maintain validation and audit trails for data used in excise-related and statutory reporting.
* Support compliance monitoring and management oversight without replacing authorised Excise, Legal, or Compliance personnel.

F. Advanced Analytics, Forecasting & Business Intelligence

* Develop predictive and statistical models for sales forecasting, demand planning, product performance, and territory-level projections.
* Apply trend analysis, variance analysis, scenario modelling, and root-cause analysis to explain deviations from business plans.
* Analyse seasonality, brand performance, pricing changes, promotional effectiveness, and market development opportunities.
* Develop early-warning indicators for declining sales, weak market coverage, inventory risks, and deteriorating commercial performance.
* Conduct profitability analysis by state, brand, SKU, depot, and channel in collaboration with Finance.
* Translate complex datasets into actionable business recommendations for the leadership team.
* Evaluate sales schemes, incentives, promotions, and market activation initiatives using defined business metrics.

G. Sales Incentive & Productivity Analytics

* Develop frameworks to monitor sales team productivity, spot sales, target achievement, and employee-wise performance.
* Evaluate the effectiveness and financial impact of incentive schemes across states, brands, and employee categories.
* Validate incentive calculations against approved eligibility criteria and underlying sales data.
* Identify unusual claims, data inconsistencies, duplicate records, and exceptions requiring management review.
* Prepare performance summaries for Sales Heads and senior management to support accountability and improvement.
* Integrate sales productivity and incentive reporting with relevant HRMS, attendance, and field-force systems where feasible.

H. Dashboard Development & Reporting Automation

* Design interactive executive dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent BI platforms.
* Develop automated reporting solutions using advanced Excel, Power Query, Power Pivot, SQL, and relevant data integration tools.
* Build dashboards with drill-down capabilities across state, region, depot, brand, SKU, channel, and sales hierarchy.
* Reduce manual data consolidation and reporting turnaround time through automated workflows and standardised data models.
* Establish data validation rules, reporting definitions, KPI dictionaries, and a single source of truth for management reporting.
* Develop management-ready presentations highlighting performance, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.

I. Leadership & Stakeholder Management

* Lead and mentor the MIS and analytics team, setting clear deliverables, reporting timelines, and quality standards.
* Work closely with Sales, Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Excise, IT, HR, and other functional stakeholders.
* Present business insights and recommendations during monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews.
* Establish reporting governance, data ownership, standard operating procedures, and escalation mechanisms across locations.
* Drive data-driven decision-making and improve analytical capabilities within business teams.

3. Educational Qualification

* MBA / PGDM / postgraduate qualification in Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, Finance, Operations, or a related discipline from a premier institute; or
* B.E. / B.Tech. / equivalent technical qualification supplemented by relevant analytics experience and, preferably, a postgraduate management qualification.
* Strong analytical reasoning, commercial understanding, and the ability to apply technical expertise to business problems are essential.

4. Experience Requirements

* 10–12 years of relevant experience in MIS, Business Intelligence, Commercial Analytics, or Business Analytics.
* Experience in the alcoholic beverages industry is strongly preferred, particularly in organisations with multi-state sales and distribution operations.
* Strong exposure to state-wise sales operations, depot networks, brand and SKU performance, pricing, and distribution analytics.
* Hands-on experience with SAP ERP reporting, preferably SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA.
* Demonstrated experience developing automated management dashboards and advanced analytics solutions.
* Experience handling large datasets and presenting actionable insights to senior management.
* Proven ability to manage cross-functional stakeholders and lead an MIS or analytics team.

5. Essential Technical Competencies

* SAP ERP: SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA, with practical exposure to SD, FI/CO, and MM reporting.
* Power BI / Tableau: Advanced dashboard development, data modelling, DAX where applicable, and BI reporting.
* Microsoft Excel: Advanced formulas, Power Query, Power Pivot, pivot tables, and automated reporting.
* SQL: Advanced querying, joins, aggregations, data extraction, and data validation.
* Advanced Analytics: Statistical analysis, predictive modelling, sales forecasting, scenario analysis, and performance diagnostics.
* Data Integration: Integration of SAP, sales systems, depot data, and other enterprise sources.
* Executive Reporting: Business review presentations, KPI design, variance analysis, and management recommendations.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* MIS Accuracy and Timeliness: Adherence to reporting schedules and accuracy of management reports.
* Reporting Automation: Reduction in manual reporting effort and turnaround time.
* Sales Analytics Effectiveness: Quality and relevance of state-wise, brand-wise, depot-wise, and employee-wise insights.
* Forecasting Accuracy: Improvement in sales and demand forecast reliability.
* SAP Data Reconciliation: Timely resolution of discrepancies between SAP and operational reporting.
* Inventory and Distribution Visibility: Effectiveness of stock monitoring, exception reporting, and distribution analysis.
* Business Intelligence Adoption: Usage and effectiveness of dashboards by senior management and functional teams.
* Commercial Insights: Quality of profitability, product mix, pricing, and sales productivity analysis.
* Regulatory Data Governance: Accuracy, completeness, and timely availability of relevant state-wise excise and compliance information.
* Team and Process Excellence: Improvement in reporting standards, team productivity, and data governance.

7. Preferred Candidate Profile

* An experienced analytics professional with a strong academic background, preferably from a premier institute, and a combination of SAP expertise, advanced analytics capability, and commercial understanding of the Indian alcobev industry.
* Capable of independently managing PAN India business reporting, analysing complex sales and operational data, identifying performance gaps, and presenting strategic recommendations to senior management.
* Able to move beyond conventional MIS reporting and build an integrated, automated, analytics-driven management information system supporting profitable growth, commercial controls, distribution efficiency, and effective business planning.

title: FP&A Senior Manager
description:
**What’s The Role**
The Reporting & Accounting Senior Manager is accountable for ensuring the effective delivery of reporting and accounting activities that support internal and external reporting requirements, business appraisal processes and financial decision-making. The role leads complex reporting operations, drives process improvements and ensures the quality, integrity and timeliness of financial reporting outputs.
  
  
The role partners closely with Reporting & Accounting Managers, Finance Leadership, Group Reporting and other finance stakeholders to strengthen reporting effectiveness, resolve reporting issues and improve end-to-end reporting processes. The role is expected to lead transformation initiatives, develop finance talent and embed best practices that enhance reporting quality, operational performance and financial stewardship.
  
  
The ideal candidate is an experienced reporting and accounting leader who combines strong technical expertise with operational leadership and continuous improvement capability. They are comfortable managing complex reporting environments, driving transformation and developing finance talent while maintaining high standards of governance, control and delivery excellence. They build trusted stakeholder relationships, solve complex reporting challenges and inspire teams to achieve sustainable performance and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Lead reporting and accounting delivery: Ensure high-quality execution of reporting and accounting activities supporting internal and external financial reporting requirements.
* Drive reporting excellence: Maintain the integrity, accuracy and timeliness of reporting outputs while ensuring compliance with accounting standards, governance requirements and reporting policies.
* Lead transformation and improvement initiatives: Manage and deliver change programmes that enhance reporting effectiveness, simplify processes and improve finance performance.
* Partner with reporting and finance leaders: Work closely with Reporting & Accounting Managers, Group Reporting and finance stakeholders to align priorities and improve reporting outcomes.
* Resolve complex reporting issues: Provide expert guidance on reporting content, accounting matters and process challenges to ensure consistent and high-quality delivery.
* Strengthen financial governance and controls: Ensure reporting activities operate within established control, assurance and compliance frameworks.
* Develop finance capability: Coach and develop reporting and accounting professionals, strengthening technical capability, leadership effectiveness and future readiness.
* Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing: Promote best practice adoption, cross-team collaboration and continuous learning across the reporting and accounting community.
* Champion digital and data-driven finance: Leverage automation, analytics and digital tools to improve reporting efficiency, transparency and insight generation.
* Drive continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve process effectiveness, standardisation and service quality across reporting and accounting activities.

**What You Bring**

* Financial reporting and accounting expertise: Deep understanding of financial reporting, accounting principles, financial close processes and governance requirements.
* Reporting process management: Experience overseeing reporting activities, reporting cycles and financial information delivery across complex organisations.
* Finance transformation and change leadership: Ability to lead large-scale change initiatives, process redesign and operational improvements.
* Problem solving and technical judgement: Ability to resolve complex reporting issues and balance technical accounting requirements with business needs.
* Performance and service delivery management: Ability to manage competing priorities, maintain delivery excellence and drive operational performance.
* Data and analytics capability: Understanding of reporting systems, financial data, automation and analytics solutions that improve finance outcomes.
* Stakeholder management and influencing: Ability to engage effectively with reporting teams, finance leaders and business stakeholders across organisational boundaries.
* People leadership and coaching: Experience developing teams, managing performance and building strong technical and leadership capability.
* Communication and executive engagement: Ability to communicate complex reporting matters clearly and provide meaningful insights to stakeholders.
* Continuous improvement mindset: Demonstrated ability to simplify, sta ndardise and optimise finance processes while maintaining strong governance.

**Leadership Expectations**

* Lead the delivery of reporting and accounting activities with a strong focus on quality, integrity and accountability.
* Create an environment that promotes collaboration, capability development and operational excellence.
* Drive reporting improvements, innovation and simplification across finance processes.
* Build strong partnerships across Reporting & Accounting, Group Reporting and wider Finance teams.
* Role model financial stewardship, governance and control discipline.
* Support and develop talent through coaching, feedback and growth opportunities.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, learning and adaptability.

**Experience And Qualifications**

* Significant experience in financial reporting, accounting, controllership, finance operations or related finance disciplines.
* Proven leadership experience managing teams, reporting activities or complex finance delivery environments.
* Strong understanding of accounting standards, reporting requirements, governance frameworks and financial controls.
* Demonstrated success leading reporting improvements, transformation initiatives or operational excellence programmes.
* Experience partnering with senior finance stakeholders and influencing organisational outcomes.
* Professional accounting qualification or relevant finance, accounting or business degree preferred.

**Success Measures**

* Timely, accurate and compliant delivery of reporting and accounting activities.
* Improved reporting quality, efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Successful delivery of reporting transformation and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong adherence to governance, assurance and financial control requirements.
* Increased capability and engagement across reporting and accounting teams.
* Effective resolution of reporting issues and improved reporting process performance.
* Measurable business value delivered through improved reporting effectiveness and decision support.

**What We Offer**
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

**An Inclusive & Progressive Place to Work**

* To power progress together, we need to attract and develop the brightest minds and make sure every voice is heard. Here are just some of the ways we’re nurturing an inclusive environment – one where you can express your ideas, extend your skills, and reach your potential.
* We’re creating a space where people with disabilities can excel through transparent recruitment process, workplace adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Feel free to let us know about your circumstances when you apply, and we’ll take it from there.
* We’re closing the gender gap – whether that’s through action on equal pay or by enabling more women to reach senior roles in engineering and technology.
* We’re striving to be a pioneer of an inclusive and diverse workplace, promoting equality for employees regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity.

**Shell in India**
Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R&D, digitalisation, and business operations.
  
  
Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050. As India moves towards its target of net-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.
  
  
Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end-to-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.
  
  
Shell owns and operates a LNG re-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Sprng Energy in a $1.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Sprng is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.
  
  
Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.
  
  
We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

Strong leadership skills with the ability to lead customer engagements at an executive level.

Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Money Market Reconciliation is responsible for reconciling Trading/IOTP (Investment Only Transmission Platform) trading activity and Cash Operations funding/money movement for all money funds and bank products. Resolution of discrepancies is achieved by working with our business partners and using several research avenues to resolve all break items promptly. The reconciliation is an intensively manual process that occurs on a daily basis.
  
  
Custody Reconciliation is primarily responsible for the position reconciliation of Mutual Fund holdings offered on the MLPF&S platform. The reconciliation performed is at the omnibus level. Internal books and records are systematically reconciled against settled transaction at the Third Party Mutual Funds through the Inventory Control System (ICS) application. Daily, the processors will be asked to create the daily Exposure report detailing unreconciled positions in ICS. In addition to creating and saving the daily exposure report, processors will be assigned Fund Groups they will be responsible for reconciling. Processors will work with both internal and external teams to fully reconcile all exception items.
  
  
Managed Account Recon is responsible for all manual reconciliations of managed accounts and the activity within them, daily. They review all accounts within multiple applications and make manual adjustments as needed. Resolution of discrepancies is achieved by working with our business partners and using several research avenues to resolve all break items promptly. The reconciliation is an intensively manual process that occurs on a daily basis.
  
  
**Job Description\***
This individual should be comfortable in a fast-paced, detail-oriented environment and is dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of accuracy and Turn around time.
  
  
The candidate is expected to resolve queries and provide support to the team in critical situations. Sense of urgency and attention to detail are pivotal competencies required to perform the functions.
  
  
The candidate must be proficient in Excel with the ability to complete multiple formula functions.
  
  
The candidate must have communication skills including written communication as the processor will need to work with both internal and external teams to perform the reconciliation.
  
  
Critical thinking skills are a must as breaks can occur for a variety of reasons due to the nature of Managed Account strategies.
  
  
The candidate must have the ability to understand ledger balances and various transaction activities to perform accurate reconciliations.
  
  
This is an extremely high risk and high dollar value reconciliation (Daily balances include Billions of Dollars)
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Complete daily deadlines in a timely manner.
* The processors will need to use critical thinking to decipher internal transactions compared to external activity that occurred at the Fund
* The processors will need to know how to decipher and compare House Account statement and client transactions.
* Provide a high level of quality service, support, and responsiveness and communicate effectively.
* Perform & review assigned month-end close responsibilities and prepare internal management reports

**Requirements\***

* Creative and analytical approach to problem solving
* The candidate should have good understanding of Booking keeping, Journal Entries, Reconciliation
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills and ability to change communication style based on the audience
* Strong knowledge in MS Office products including MS Excel, PowerPoint
* Attention to details and drive for accuracy
* Ability to work well under pressure
* Flexible for shifts

**Education\***
Minimum Commerce Graduate
  
  
Certifications If Any - Any certification in finance or banking
  
  
**Experience Range\***
60 months to 84 months
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Basic banking, Reconciliation and Wealth management knowledge
* Good communication and listening skills.
* Strong analytical skills with great attention to details
* Organized and able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment

**Desired skills:**

* Highly motivated, able to work independently

* Willingness to learn and adapt to changes
* Good knowledge with Microsoft Excel & PPT

title: GCC Demand Management & Planning Lead
description:
**Job Description**

**Role Summary-**

The GCC Demand Management & Planning Lead is responsible for managing the complete process of identifying, approving, planning, and fulfilling business demands for SMBC Global Services (GCC) in India.

The role serves as the main point of contact between regional business teams and GCC teams, ensuring that requests for new roles, additional headcount, and business support services are properly documented, approved, and executed in line with the organization’s growth plans and governance standards.

The individual will work closely with business leaders, HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Risk, Compliance, and other functional teams to coordinate workforce planning, recruitment, approvals, and transition activities. The role also involves managing project timelines, tracking progress, resolving issues, maintaining governance documentation, and ensuring that new services are transitioned to the GCC smoothly and efficiently.

**Key Responsibilities**
-

1. Demand Intake and Requirement Gathering

· Act as the main contact for regional teams requesting new roles or additional resources in the GCC.

· Understand the business need, required headcount, job responsibilities, and hiring priorities.

· Ensure all requests have the necessary information and business justification.

· Maintain a central tracker to monitor all incoming requests and their progress.

2. Demand Governance and Approvals

· Track each request through the required approval process.

· Ensure all necessary regional approvals and supporting documents are available before recruitment begins.

· Maintain proper records and evidence for audits and governance reviews.

· Follow up on pending approvals and escalate delays or missing documentation.

3. Job Description and Requisition Management

· Work with business stakeholders to prepare and improve job descriptions.

· Ensure job descriptions meet GCC requirements and organizational standards.

· Prepare job requisition forms based on approved job descriptions.

· Coordinate internal approvals so that recruitment can begin on time.

4. Recruitment Coordination and Tracking

· Monitor the recruitment progress of all approved positions.

· Work with HR and Talent Acquisition teams to track vacancies, interviews, and hiring status.

· Identify recruitment delays and coordinate with the relevant teams to resolve them.

· Participate in hiring discussions and recruitment review meetings.

5. Stakeholder Management and Communication

· Build strong working relationships with regional business teams and GCC stakeholders.

· Organize regular meetings to review demand, approvals, recruitment progress, and outstanding issues.

· Provide regular status updates to management and stakeholders.

· Identify risks, issues, and dependencies early and ensure appropriate follow-up.

6. Workforce Planning and Continuous Improvement

· Support workforce planning and GCC expansion across technology, operations, and corporate functions.

· Analyze demand trends and provide reports to help management make informed decisions.

· Improve demand management processes, governance standards, and reporting methods.

· Coordinate with Corporate Function leaders to support Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) assessments.

·Collect and consolidate documents and evidence required for TPRM reviews.

· Track outstanding TPRM actions and ensure requests from regional and governance teams are addressed on time.

7. Cross-Functional Coordination

· Manage demand requests across HR, Treasury, Compliance, Risk Management, Data, Finance, Operations, and other corporate functions.

· Work with subject matter experts to understand the requirements of different roles and business areas.

· Ensure consistent processes, documentation, approvals, and recruitment practices across all functions.

8. Project Management and Reporting

· Manage the overall plan for demand-related initiatives, including timelines, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies.

· Lead coordination meetings, governance forums, and weekly status reviews.

· Work with multiple teams, including regional stakeholders, GCC, HR, Finance, Risk, Compliance, and Technology.

· Prepare weekly reports, dashboards, action trackers, risk logs, and decision records.

· Ensure activities are completed within agreed timelines and that stakeholders remain informed.

9. Transition Management and Operational Readiness

· Coordinate the complete transition process when a new role, function, or service moves to the GCC.

· Manage activities from initial demand approval and recruitment through knowledge transfer, operational readiness, stabilization, and final handover.

· Prepare transition plans, readiness checklists, timelines, and dependency trackers.

· Identify potential transition risks and resolve gaps before they affect delivery.

· Ensure the GCC is ready to take ownership of new services and operate them effectively.

description:

**Description**
At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd
  
  
**VPU Context**
The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150+ locations.
  
  
For more information on ITS, see video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload=9&v=VTFGffa1Y7w
  
  
**Unit Context**
The WBG Corporate Solutions Department (ITSCO) is focused on the digital transformation of essential corporate services to ensure WBG operations are seamless, resilient, and future ready. Uniting digitalization roadmaps, experience design, process optimization, application delivery, systems management, and technology modernization across 70+ products, the department links business ambition with operational excellence - from intuitive employee experiences and precision payroll to data-driven decision making, intelligent automation, and AI enablement. The unit will oversee vital corporate systems such as personnel administration, global payroll, benefits, tax, pension, budget and planning, cost and expense management, internal audit, ethics and justice processes, heath services, and other essential corporate services. These operations—and their supporting platforms—demand uncompromising accuracy, confidentiality, and resilience, operating in environments where reliability is non-negotiable.
  
  
**Duties And Accountabilities**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect leads the execution of strategic business requirements by designing integrated, AI-ready technology solutions and guiding their implementation across software, data, and cloud infrastructure. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role synthesizes business, information, and technical perspectives to create scalable architectures aligned with enterprise principles. By evaluating functionality, constraints, and compatibility across platforms, it ensures interoperability, stability, usability, and high availability in distributed environments, enabling corporate application teams to deliver with greater velocity, quality, and efficiency.
  
  

* Translate budget policy changes and new WBP requirements into functional and technical specifications for planning models, allocation rules, workflows, and approval routing.
* Define integration patterns between the planning tools, SAP ERP/FM, HR position data, and the enterprise data platform, keeping one consistent version of budget and actuals.
* Design, configure, and support planning applications in Jedox, including cubes, rules, Integrator jobs, and web reports and forms, alongside other periphal enterprise tools in use.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for SAP BW on HANA data models, planning functions,
* Partner with data engineering teams to integrate budget, actuals, and commitment data into the enterprise reporting tools such as Azure Databricks
* Deliver trusted budget-versus-actual, trajectory, and performance reporting for WBP, VPU budget teams, and senior management.
* Identify and shape AI-enabled opportunities, such as anomaly detection in budget submissions, forecasting support, and natural-language access to budget data, with responsible AI and human oversight built in.

Selection Criteria
  
  

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Engineering, or a related field with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience; OR a Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in enterprise planning, budgeting systems, or SAP BI; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Advanced expertise in areas – Data Analysis, Data Engineering, Reporting and Planning.
* Required Certifications: Scaled Agile certification (SAFe Architect, SAFe POPM, or SAFe Agilist); Any of the data technology such as Azure Synapse, Databricks or SAP BW/4HANA or SAP BW on HANA (or equivalent SAP BI/HANA certification); Any of the data engineering such as Databricks, Azure, GCP
* Recommended: Jedox Certified Modeler or Jedox Certified Consultant;
* Optional: TOGAF, or a public financial management credential (e.g., CIPFA, IPSAS certificate).
* Demonstrated experience leading the modernization of corporate budget and planning systems — including end to end implementation of planning applications across large, multi-stakeholder organizations with complex financial planning structures.
* Strong ability to translate organizational budget priorities and financial planning requirements into practical Jedox implementation strategies, phased rollout roadmaps, configuration decisions, and measurable planning outcomes
* Advanced expertise in at least two relevant disciplines, such as financial planning and analysis (FP&A), budget system architecture, Jedox model design, reporting, process redesign for planning cycles, organizational change management, or performance management frameworks.
* Proven systems-thinking skills applied to budget and planning environments, including the ability to identify cross-functional data dependencies, resolve model integrity issues, and address root causes of planning inefficiencies within Jedox or connected systems.
* Strong advisory and facilitation skills, with experience building trust among finance leads, budget owners, IT teams, and senior management to drive adoption of Jedox-based planning processes and data-driven decision-making
* Alongside planning expertise, a strong grasp of modern data technologies, including relational, columnar in-memory (e.g., SAP HANA), MPP warehouse, file-based (Parquet/Delta on cloud storage), and distributed processing platforms (e.g., Apache Spark, Databricks). Also hands-on experience with enterprise reporting tools such as Power BI, SAP BusinessObjects, and Analysis for Office.
* Understanding of AI-enabled forecasting, predictive analytics, and emerging automation capabilities within modern planning platforms – Planning and Reporting.

As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:
  
  

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
* Bring experience working in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV) contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.

**WBG Culture Attributes**

* Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.
* Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
* Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

World Bank Group Core Competencies
  
  
The World Bank Group offers comprehensive benefits, including a retirement plan; medical, life and disability insurance; and paid leave, including parental leave, as well as reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities.
  
  
We are proud to be an equal opportunity and inclusive employer with a dedicated and committed workforce, and do not discriminate based on gender, gender identity, religion, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability.

* Be able to provide consulting services to various stakeholders within the company, including guidance around the development, or revision, of Company policies and procedures.
* Be an example for Senior Auditors and Auditors to look upto and be available to coach them on skillset improvements as required.

* Excellent report writing and verbal communication/presentation skills is a must. Advanced knowledge of excel. Experience with data analytics/visualization tools is required. Roles
* Prior experience with audit software such as Optro

数字、計上、書類が正しく入力されているか、数学的に正確か、適切なコードがあるかチェックする。方針および手続きに従い、すべてのファイル、記録、現金および現金同等物を整理、保全、維持する。コンピュータ化された財務情報の記録、保存、アクセス、および/または分析。財務および会計データの正確な電子スプレッドシートを管理する。日誌、元帳、コンピュータを使用して、財務記録を編集・保管するために、数値データや財務データを分類、コード化、要約する。統計、財務、会計、監査、または給与報告書や表を作成、維持、配布する。指定された期末決算手続きと報告を行う。請求書、請求書、勘定明細書の作成、レビュー、照合、発行する。
  
  
会社の方針と手続きに従うこと。制服と身だしなみが清潔でプロフェッショナルであることを確認すること。専有情報の守秘義務を守り、会社の資産を保護すること。ゲストと同僚のプライバシーとセキュリティを保護すること。プロフェッショナルで積極的、かつタイムリーな方法でゲストのサービスニーズに対応すること。明瞭でプロフェッショナルな言葉遣いで他人と会話する；書面を正確かつ完璧に準備・確認する；適切なエチケットを守って電話やEメールに応対する。重さ10ポンド以下の物を補助なしで移動、持ち上げ、運び、押し、引き、置くことができる。 他の従業員との良好な関係を築き、維持し、チームが共通の目標を達成できるようサポートする。他の従業員の懸念に耳を傾け、適切に対応すること。

ライセンスまたは認定: なし

コートヤード・バイ・マリオットでは、あらゆる場所で旅するお客様のニーズによりよく応えることに情熱を注いでいます。これは、現代のビジネストラベラーのニーズに特化した最初のホテルを作ることとなったきっかけでもあり、また、旅行の目的に関わらず今日のコートヤード・バイ・マリオットでの体験がお客様に活力をもたらす理由でもあります。私たちは、お客様に期待を上回る体験を提供し、小さいながらも野心的なチームの一員であることを楽しみ、常に向上心を忘れず、そしてこれらすべてを楽しみながら行うことに情熱を傾けられる優秀な人材を求めています。

title: General Manager – Revenue Cycle Management
description:
**Company:**
Acurus Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (a wholly-owned subsidiary of Akido)
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India (on-site, with required overlap with US Pacific and Eastern business hours)
  
  
**Reports to:**
VP of Operations, Akido
  
  
**Key US Partners:**
RCM Director (US), Global IT Lead, Medical Group Operations leadership
  
  
**Direct Reports:**
AGM Operations, Process/Delivery Managers, Training Lead, WFM/MIS Lead, HR Business Partner (dotted line)
  
  
**Team Size:**
140 FTEs across billing, coding, AR, payment posting, and support functions
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time, permanent
  
  
**About Us**
Akido is an AI-native health system operating approximately 100 clinics across California, New York, and Rhode Island, including Chaparral Medical Group, an ~80-physician multi-specialty group serving more than 250,000 patients in California's Inland Empire. Akido's care footprint spans primary and specialty care, managed care populations, and street medicine and Enhanced Care Management (ECM) programs serving some of the most vulnerable patients in the US.
  
  
Acurus Solutions is Akido's captive central business office (CBO) in Chennai. Acurus delivers end-to-end revenue cycle, front-office, and back-office services to Akido's clinics and is a core part of Akido's strategy to combine skilled people with AI automation to run a best-in-class revenue cycle.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The General Manager – RCM is the senior-most operations leader at Acurus and owns the performance, people, compliance, and transformation of the India revenue cycle operation. This person is accountable for the financial outcomes Acurus delivers to Akido: collections, AR health, denial prevention, and cost-to-collect. They run Acurus as a business, not just a production floor.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role. The GM must be equally comfortable reviewing a payer denial trend line by line, presenting a monthly business review to US executives, resolving a staffing crisis, and partnering with technology teams to automate work that people do today. The right candidate will bring deep US healthcare RCM expertise, a track record of leading large offshore teams, and genuine enthusiasm for using AI and automation to change how revenue cycle work gets done.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Revenue Cycle Performance and Delivery
* Own end-to-end delivery of Acurus RCM services, including eligibility and benefits verification, prior authorization support, charge entry, medical coding support, claim submission and scrubbing, payment posting (ERA and manual), AR follow-up, denial management, appeals, credit balance resolution, and patient statement support.
* Deliver against agreed KPIs and SLAs, including net collection rate, days in AR, AR over 90/120 days, clean claim rate, first-pass resolution rate, denial rate by category, posting lag, charge lag, and touch-to-resolution metrics.
* Drive root-cause analysis on denials and underpayments and translate findings into upstream fixes in partnership with US clinic operations, coding, and credentialing teams.
* Manage payer-specific complexity across Medicare, Medi-Cal and other Medicaid programs, Medicare Advantage, commercial payers, IPA/MSO capitated arrangements, and workers' compensation.
* Ensure claims are routed through the most efficient channel (electronic vs. paper), payer mapping is accurate, and clearinghouse rejections are worked promptly.
* Oversee write-off governance, ensuring adjustments follow approved policy and thresholds and are supported by documentation.
* Operational Governance and Reporting
* Lead the monthly business review (MBR) process with Akido leadership, presenting performance, trends, risks, and improvement plans with clear, data-backed narratives.
* Run a disciplined operating cadence: daily production huddles, weekly performance reviews, and monthly/quarterly business reviews.
* Maintain accurate and timely MIS reporting on productivity, quality, inventory aging, and financial outcomes; ensure a single source of truth with the US team.
* Clearly define and maintain the division of responsibilities between the onshore (US) RCM team and Acurus, including escalation paths, handoffs, and ownership of exceptions.
* Maintain current, auditable SOPs, desk-level procedures, and process maps for every workstream.
* People Leadership and Talent
* Lead, develop, and retain a large multi-layer team, building a strong bench of managers and team leads with clear succession plans for every critical role.
* Own workforce planning: capacity modeling, hiring plans, shift design, and FTE redeployment as volumes shift or automation reduces manual work.
* Maintain attrition, absenteeism, and engagement at or better than industry benchmarks for Chennai healthcare BPO.
* Build structured training programs covering new-hire onboarding, payer and specialty refreshers, compliance, and upskilling into higher-value work (analytics, automation support, complex denials).
* Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement, with performance management that is fair, transparent, and consistent.
* Automation, AI, and Transformation
* Partner with Akido's IT, product, and automation teams to identify, prioritize, and implement automation opportunities (RPA, AI agents, voice AI for payer calls, auto-posting, intelligent work queues, denial prediction).
* Redesign workflows and roles as automation is introduced, ensuring the team evolves from high-volume manual processing to exception handling, oversight, and analytics.
* Evaluate and support adoption of new RCM tools and vendors, providing an operational perspective on fit, effort, and ROI.
* Support EHR/PM system transitions, data migrations, and new clinic or acquisition onboarding with minimal disruption to cash flow.
* Compliance, Security, and Quality
* Ensure full compliance with HIPAA, HITECH, and Akido's privacy and information security policies, including access controls, PHI handling, clean-desk policies, and incident reporting.
* Support internal and external audits (security, quality, payer, and client audits) and maintain audit-ready documentation at all times.
* Maintain and strengthen quality management systems, including QA sampling, error categorization, calibration, and corrective action plans.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian labor laws, statutory requirements, and company HR policies in partnership with HR and legal.
* Financial and Business Management
* Own the Acurus operating budget, including headcount, facilities, technology, and overhead; manage to cost-per-FTE and cost-to-collect targets.
* Identify efficiency gains and present business cases for investment.
* Partner with finance on accurate cost allocation and reporting to Akido.
* Stakeholder Management
* Serve as the primary point of accountability for RCM with Akido's US leadership.
* Build trusted, transparent relationships with the US RCM Director, clinic operations leaders, IT, finance, and compliance.
* Escalate risks early and come with options, not just problems.

Key Performance Indicators
  
  
**Area**
**Example Measures**
Cash & AR
  
  
Net collection rate, days in AR, % AR > 90 / > 120 days, cash vs. target
  
  
Claims & Denials
  
  
Clean claim rate, first-pass resolution rate, denial rate, denial overturn rate, timely filing write-offs
  
  
Productivity & Quality
  
  
Productivity vs. standard, quality/accuracy %, inventory aging, SLA adherence
  
  
People
  
  
Voluntary attrition, absenteeism, internal promotion rate, training completion
  
  
Cost & Transformation
  
  
Cost-to-collect, cost per FTE, hours/FTEs released through automation
  
  
Compliance
  
  
Audit findings, security incidents, SOP currency
  
  
*Specific targets will be set with the VP of Operations during onboarding.*
**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in commerce, business, life sciences, or a related field.
* 15+ years of experience in US healthcare revenue cycle management, with at least 5–7 years in a senior leadership role (Senior Manager, AGM, or above) running an offshore RCM operation.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams of 150+ FTEs, including managers and team leads.
* Deep, hands-on knowledge of the end-to-end US revenue cycle for physician/professional billing in a multi-specialty setting.
* Strong working knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid (Medi-Cal experience strongly preferred), Medicare Advantage, managed care/capitation, and commercial payer rules.
* Proven track record of improving AR days, collections, and denial rates with measurable results.
* Experience presenting to and managing US executive stakeholders.
* Strong command of RCM metrics and data, with high proficiency in Excel and comfort with BI/reporting tools.
* Excellent written and spoken English; clear, direct communicator.

**Preferred**

* MBA or postgraduate degree in management.
* Experience in a captive CBO (as opposed to only third-party BPO).
* Experience with NextGen, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, Epic, or similar PM/EHR systems, and with clearinghouses such as Availity, Waystar, or Change Healthcare.
* Hands-on involvement in RPA, AI, or automation programs within RCM.
* Certifications such as CPC, CPB, CRCR (HFMA), or Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt.
* Experience with ISO 9001 / ISO 27001 or SOC 2 environments.
* Exposure to value-based care, FQHC, street medicine, or ECM programs.

Core Competencies
  
  

* **Business ownership:**
  Thinks in terms of cash, cost, and outcomes, not just volume and productivity.
* **Analytical rigor:**
  Uses data to find root causes and make decisions; challenges assumptions.
* **Transformation mindset:**
  Welcomes automation and actively redesigns work around it.
* **People leadership:**
  Builds strong teams, develops leaders, and holds people accountable with respect.
* **Integrity and compliance:**
  Treats patient data and payer rules with the seriousness they require.
* **Executive presence:**
  Communicates crisply and credibly across cultures and time zones.
* **Resilience:**
  Stays steady and solution-focused under pressure.

Working Conditions
  
  

* Based on-site at the Acurus office in Chennai.
* Regular overlap with US business hours (including early morning or late evening IST calls) is required.
* Occasional travel to the US may be required.
