title: Manager-Internal FC Framework
description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Risk and Control manager to document and maintain process and controls documentation for the financial control team within GCFO. The candidate should have a deep understanding of Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) requirements for internal controls over financial reporting (ICOFR) which have been encapsulated within the bank’s financial reporting controls framework (FRCF). The candidate will be responsible for identifying and mitigating risks and enhancing the internal control environment within GCFO. This role requires a deep understanding of financial reporting processes, risk management, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Report to the team lead will oversee the following activities performed by the team:**

* Training & Education: Help first line control owners understand and meet regulatory requirements relating to ICOFR either by helping to deliver existing training materials for ICOFR or by setting up bespoke training for first line control and process managers/owners.
* Remediation: Help first line control owners to remediate controls that fail design or operating effectiveness testing
* Control design and implementation - Work with first line control owners to design and implement robust internal controls to ensure the accuracy and reliability of financial reporting. Evaluate existing internal controls and implement improvements to enhance control effectiveness.
* Control documentation – Work with and assist first line teams to ensure controls are properly documented and maintained.
* Reporting and Communication: Act as the primary liaison with the Finance Risk & Governance team for the completion of FRCF lifecycle activities on behalf of GCFO. Help Finance Risk and Governance team coordinate and manage control testing activities with first line control owners. Work with the second line Finance Risk & Governance team to help ensure all issues and control deficiencies are logged within the bank’s strategic GRC tooling and the impact on ICOFR is risk assessed.

**Strategy**

* To help GCFO first line teams so they can comply with regulatory requirements prescribed within the UK Corporate Governance Code for internal controls over financial reporting (ICOFR).

**Business**

* The successful candidate will be working with colleagues across GCFO, Finance Risk & Governance and business stakeholders across the wider bank to successfully implement controls that help GCFO meet ICOFR requirements.

**Processes**
**Within GCFO Financial Control Work To**

* Design and implement robust internal controls to ensure the accuracy and reliability of financial reporting.
* Evaluate existing internal controls and recommend improvements to enhance control effectiveness.
* Work with process owners to update process and controls documentation to reflect changes in business process or supporting technology/ systems.
* Work with process owners to ensure that controls that fail design or operating effectiveness testing are suitably remediated

**People & Talent**

* Help upskill GCFO staff, so they understand ICOFR requirements and best practices. The candidate must have strong interpersonal and communication skills (oral and written English) as well as networking and negotiation skills. Maintain a positive attitude with the motivation to work under pressure and deliver on multiple deadlines.

**Risk Management**

* Help the team lead to ensure that GCFO Financial Control complies with regulatory requirements prescribed within the UK Corporate Governance Code for internal controls over financial reporting by ensuring process and controls documentation is regularly updated and defective controls are remediated. Work with the second line Finance Risk & Governance team to help ensure all issues and control deficiencies are logged within the bank’s strategic GRC tooling and the impact on ICOFR is risk assessed.

**Governance**

* Support the team lead with providing inputs to the Finance Risk & Governance team for governance papers including information to populate supporting dashboards and metrics on all FRCF Lifecycle activities that impact Group Finance.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify and mitigate risks relating to internal controls over financial reporting for Group Finance.

**Key stakeholders**

* Group CFO global process owners, process manager and control owners
* Finance CIO
* Finance Change
* Finance Risk & Governance team
* Group Internal Audit

**Skills And Experience**

* Business Process Mapping and end-to-end linkage between different teams
* Data Mining, Interpretation and Dashboarding
* Agile Working & Flexibility
* Eye for detail and with a strong focus on controls and compliance to policies and procedures
* Ability to form effective relationships with key stakeholders
* Self-motivated individual and able to drive results. And able to work independently.
* Strong team player and has the capacity to build good working relationships with cross functional / geographical teams
* Proven ability to perform under pressure and stress and to adjust plans to meet changing needs and requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Qualified risk practioner or professional Finance qualification

You will bring a detail-oriented, analytical, customer-service-focused approach while supporting effective governance and continuous improvement.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Manage enterprise software demand, including intake, validation, prioritization, forecasting, and ongoing tracking. Validate requests against inventory, existing entitlements, approved standards, usage data, and technology roadmaps to recommend appropriate fulfillment paths.

* Apply AI-enabled analytics and automation to demand forecasting, spend anomaly detection, license optimization, compliance monitoring, renewal readiness, and reporting. Define, develop, test, deploy, and manage AI agents with appropriate human oversight, role-based access, data privacy, model and prompt controls, traceability, accuracy monitoring, exception escalation, and continuous improvement.
* Maintain data quality standards, controls, procedures, decision records, evidence, and audit-ready documentation. Research licensing and technology changes, partner with application owners, architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure, finance, legal, risk, and other stakeholders, and support software standardization, catalog governance, rationalization, reclamation, reharvesting, and retirement initiatives.

**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* A bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, computer science, finance, analytics, or a related discipline.
* 7–10 years of experience in IT vendor management, software asset management, technology demand management, license compliance, IT governance, or a related function.
* Strong understanding of software licensing models, entitlement records, deployment and usage data, subscriptions, cloud consumption, and infrastructure-related licensing concepts.
* Experience working with software asset management, configuration management, IT service management, inventory, reporting, or business intelligence platforms.
* Ability to analyze large and varied data sets, identify trends and control gaps, reconcile records, and present decision-ready insights.
* Experience with technology spend analytics, budget planning, forecasting, allocation, variance analysis, financial modeling, and executive-level reporting.
* Practical knowledge of AI-enabled analytics, intelligent automation, and the AI-agent lifecycle, including use-case definition, data and workflow design, testing, deployment, governance, monitoring, and adoption.
* Knowledge of audit readiness, evidence management, data governance, policy compliance, risk assessment, and remediation tracking.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical licensing and compliance concepts to senior leaders and non-technical stakeholders.
* Excellent customer service, critical thinking, decision-making, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for work that serves a greater good for customers, communities, or global challenges.
* Embodiment of Cognizant’s Values: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The Right Thing, and Own It.

**These will help you succeed**

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn complex licensing, technology, financial, and compliance information into actionable recommendations.
* Ability to build strong cross-functional relationships and collaborate effectively across technology and business functions.
* Strong attention to detail and disciplined documentation and follow-through.
* A continuous-improvement mindset with an interest in AI-enabled intelligence and automation.
* Effective time management and the ability to manage multiple demand, licensing, compliance, renewal, and reporting priorities.

**Work model**
We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in Cognizant office. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

description:
About the Role

Anoud Technologies is looking for an experienced Assistant Manager – Finance & Administration to support the Finance Head in running day-to-day finance operations from our Chennai office. You will own the accuracy of payments, reconciliations, MIS, payroll and statutory filings (GST, TDS), support budgeting, audits and financial reporting, and coordinate procurement and office administration. The role suits a hands-on finance professional who combines strong technical accounting with sound controls, ownership and stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities

**Finance Operations & Controls**

* Support the oversight of daily Finance Department operations, ensuring all activities follow approved policies, procedures and the Delegation of Authority (DoA) Matrix.
* Review utility, supplier and vendor payments for accuracy and completeness before they go for approval and processing.
* Monitor and verify bank reconciliations across all company accounts, and drive timely closure of outstanding reconciling items.
* Maintain fixed asset records and strengthen internal control processes.

**Accounting, Reporting & Analysis**

* Assist in managing accounting, financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting.
* Prepare monthly MIS reports and carry out financial analysis to support management decisions.
* Support quarterly and annual financial statement preparation, and coordinate internal and external audits.
* Track project costs, budget variances, cash flow and operational expenses.

**Payroll & Statutory Compliance**

* Oversee payroll processing, vendor payments and bank reconciliations.
* Ensure timely and accurate statutory compliance, including GST and TDS.

**Procurement & Administration**

* Coordinate procurement activities, vendor management and office administration functions.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 7 to 12 years of relevant experience in finance, accounts and compliance.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian accounting standards (Ind AS / Indian GAAP), GST, TDS, payroll processing and statutory compliance.
* Hands-on experience in budgeting, forecasting and financial reporting.
* Good understanding of financial analysis, MIS reporting, cash flow management and internal controls.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
* Experience with ERP systems is an added advantage.

Behavioural Competencies

* Clear communication and strong stakeholder management skills.
* Analytical, problem-solving mindset with close attention to detail.
* Ability to prioritise, handle multiple assignments and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Self-motivated and proactive, with ownership and accountability for assigned work.
* Team player who coordinates smoothly with finance, operations, HR, procurement and external stakeholders.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to changing business needs.
* High integrity and confidentiality, with commitment to organisational objectives.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Consulting – SAP – CPM Functional – Manager:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a skilled SAP Commercial Project Management (CPM) Consultant to support the design, implementation, enhancement, and maintenance of SAP CPM solutions. The role offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of large-scale SAP transformation programs while developing expertise at the intersection of finance, strategy, project delivery, and commercial management.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Commercial Project Governance**

* Act as the commercial lead for SAP implementation, support, migration, and transformation programs.
* Establish and maintain commercial governance frameworks across project portfolios.
* Support project leadership in ensuring projects are delivered within approved budgets, schedules, and contractual commitments.
* Drive project profitability while balancing customer satisfaction and delivery objectives.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, financial controls, and regulatory requirements.

**Financial Management & Project Controlling**

* Own project financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting activities.
* Monitor project revenue, costs, gross margins, and cash flow performance.
* Analyze project financial health and proactively identify variances against forecasts.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reviews.
* Drive corrective actions to improve project profitability and financial performance.
* Ensure accurate revenue recognition and project accounting in line with corporate and statutory requirements.

**Contract & Commercial Management**

* Review customer contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), Master Service Agreements (MSAs), and change requests.
* Ensure contractual obligations, commercial terms, and project assumptions are properly managed.
* Identify contractual risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Lead commercial negotiations related to scope changes, claims management, and contract amendments.
* Support bid reviews and project handovers from sales to delivery teams.

**Risk Management**

* Identify financial, contractual, operational, and compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop risk mitigation plans and track closure of identified risks.
* Monitor project performance indicators and escalate issues proactively.
* Support contingency planning and financial recovery strategies where applicable.

**Portfolio & Business Performance Management**

* Manage commercial oversight for multiple SAP projects and accounts.
* Track portfolio-level financial metrics including revenue, backlog, utilization, margin, and working capital.
* Provide insights and recommendations to improve overall business performance.
* Support leadership with dashboards, KPIs, and executive reporting.

**Change Request and Scope Management**

* Ensure all scope changes are formally assessed and approved.
* Quantify financial and commercial impacts of project changes.
* Collaborate with delivery and customer stakeholders to secure change order approvals.
* Maximize revenue realization through effective scope management.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with Project Managers, Program Managers, Delivery Leads, and Customer Executives.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on commercial and financial matters.
* Communicate project financial performance to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support successful project execution.

**Compliance & Audit Support**

* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and governance requirements.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Maintain project documentation supporting financial and commercial decisions.
* Ensure adherence to revenue recognition, procurement, and financial reporting standards.

**Team Leadership & People Development**

* Mentor and coach junior CPM professionals and project controllers.
* Drive best practices in commercial management across SAP programs.
* Contribute to organizational capability development and process improvements.
* Participate in recruitment, performance management, and career development activities.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 8+ years of experience in project financial management, commercial management, project controlling, or program governance.
* Experience in SAP implementation, ERP transformation, managed services, or consulting environments.
* Strong understanding of project accounting, budgeting, forecasting, and revenue recognition.
* Knowledge of contract management and commercial risk management principles.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**

description:

**About the Role:** 




  






 We are seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented Senior Accounting Specialist to manage core financial operations, support global compliance, and drive reporting accuracy. **Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* **Global Entity Accounting \& Intercompany Transactions:** 

 Oversee the accounting for Giggso’s international operations in India and the Middle East. Ensure local statutory and tax compliance, prepare foreign currency translations for financial consolidation, and record intercompany transactions in accordance with transfer pricing guidelines while maintaining US GAAP conformity.
* **Full\-Cycle Bookkeeping \& Month\-End Close:** 

 Manage daily accounting activities, including accounts payable (vendor onboarding, invoice processing) and accounts receivable. Execute month\-end close tasks, manage cash postings, and perform bank reconciliations.
* **Payroll \& Statutory Compliance (India):**
* Process monthly payroll for Indian employees, including calculation and deposit of
 
**TDS, PF, ESI, and Professional Tax** 

 .
* Complete monthly/quarterly tax filings and prepare schedules for GST, TDS returns, and local statutory requirements.
* Assist external auditors during statutory, tax, and internal financial audits.
* **Budgets \& Forecasts:** 

 Assist leadership in the preparation of annual budgets and rolling financial forecasts. Analyze financial data to identify trends, track performance against budget, and provide actionable variance analysis.
* **Audit \& Financial Reporting:** 

 Support the preparation of accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, cashflow, P\&L, balance sheet etc. Act as a key liaison for internal and external audits, preparing necessary schedules and documentation to ensure smooth audit cycles.
* **Payroll \& Tax Compliance:** 

 Lead the preparation and review of payroll across our operational regions. Coordinate state, federal, and international tax registrations, manage tax notices, and administer the expense reimbursement process while ensuring strict adherence to local labor and compliance laws.
* **Commissions \& Variable Compensation** 

 : Review variable compensation plans for sales and implementation teams, validate commission statements, prepare commission journal entries, and reconcile commission reports to the general ledger.
* **Process Improvement \& Troubleshooting:** 

 Partner with operations and leadership to investigate and resolve issues within project or contract transaction data. Continuously identify opportunities to streamline accounting workflows, implement better financial controls, and improve efficiency as the company scales.

* **Education:** 

 Bachelor’s degree in Commerce (B.Com) required; M.Com, MBA in Finance

 4 to 6 years of total accounting experience, with at least 2\+ years handling IT/ITeS industry accounting.

 Hands\-on experience with accounting tools such as
 
**Tally, ERP, Zoho Books** 

 ,
 
**QuickBooks** 

 , etc.
* **Tax Knowledge:** 

 Working understanding of Indian tax laws (GST, TDS, PF/ESI) and familiarity with US cross\-border accounting concepts.
* **Key Skills:** 

 Advanced MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables), strong financial analysis capabilities, budgeting and forecasting, reporting and clear written/verbal English communication.

 Giggso, founded in 2017 in Michigan, helps enterprises navigate the complexities of digital transformation with a strong focus on AI governance with its offshore development center in Chennai and Hyderabad, India.  **Information Technology** 
 division.

**Job Description:** 




**Job Summary:** 




 Financial Controller – Finance SL will be responsible to lead and deliver all controllership activities including but not limited to accounting, reconciliation, substantiation, reporting and disclosure for the service company financials whose main business is to design, develop and maintain software intangibles for their end users. The governance responsibility of this role extends to upstream process and controls in COO and CIO organisation and collaboration with Tax and Treasury teams. This role would partner with business to achieving the organization goals and the commercial objectives of the business. The role will be accountable for integrity and accuracy of financial reporting in accordance with IFRS and various other local statutory requirements. The role will manage book close process, financial reporting for Group and legal entity working closely with Cost Management, Business Finance, Group Finance, Technology \& Operations, Country based finance teams.
 



  





 Designing FRCF controls for SL based on its business and operational objectives leading to impeccable control and integrity of financial information is an integral part of the responsibilities. Role will be responsible to have strong engagement model with Tech CFOs, Business Finance, COO, CIO and GPO Cost Management to provide best in class financial reporting and risk management with provision of strong control governance framework. In addition to oversight across the breadth of day\-to\-day delivery, the broad areas covered within this role include:
 


* Managing, delivering, and governing financial controller related reporting and analytics requirements.
* Strategic direction and oversight of designing processes that will enhance Controls and outcomes.
* Support designing and execution of Finance change journey. This role will also lead activities and functions required for SL Board for its effective governance over the financials.



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Operating Model Strategy
* Partner with Cost management, Tech CFO and Global Process Owner to formulate and execute day 1 strategy for servco implementation.
* Collaborate with Finance leadership team to embed new servco strategy, control framework and process design to deliver requirements under intangibles and IGAR.
* Design and implement team structure optimising core controllership \& Governance outcomes.
* Partner with the Global Process Owner and Group Controller Office to design and execute the controllers’ mandate for the Legal entities and Business segments with End\-to\-End responsibility and accountability by leveraging on best practices across GCCs in India.
* Work closely with COOs and CIOs to achieve investment capitalization outcomes.



  





**Business and Processes** 




**Financial Controller** 



* Work closely with COO, CIO, Group Tax, Cost Management and SL Finance Heads to ensure seamless period\-close in accordance with accounting standards and practices in timely manner.
* Perform Analytical review of IFRS Financials and disclosures to explain business drivers and ensure there are no material issues / errors.
* Develop strong understanding of firm’s accounting and governance policies and ensure compliance of same.
* Establish clear guidelines that will drive decisions around close acceleration.
* Ensure Primary and Secondary financial statements are prepared in accordance with statutory and regulatory requirements for accountable captions in timely manner. Support Group Financial and Local Statutory reporting for LE \& Group.
* Work with Tech CFO and project teams for effective controls around software intangibles.
* Oversee SL balance sheet substantiation process and remediate any risk and control issues.
* Secretarial function for the SL Board.
* Banking and funding management for SL and its branches.
* Manage key control forums at LE \& Tech segment level with appropriate KRI \& KPI reporting with aim to monitor open items and its implications covering risks and audit issues.
* Collaborate with the change \& technology teams for upstream issue fixes to help resolve gaps.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Qualified Accountant with 20\+ years’ work experience in leading \& managing Finance controller function.
* Strong financial control experience of Cost, Investment Capitalization, Finance Risk \& Governance.
* Have a sound knowledge on the right\-shoring model (preferably with a financial services background).
* Ability to work well under pressure, strong problem\-solving skills and some hands\-on operational experience.
* Strategic mindset with strong experience in implementation of strategic changes as well as Knowledge of IFRS and standard accounting practices etc.
* Excellent business judgment, operational control management and risk assessment.
* Strong connect with business performance metrics and how it is enabled through good process discipline.
* Should have strong knowledge and understanding of data management, data quality and its linkage in driving business performance management.
* Good eye for detail and with a strong focus on controls and compliance to policies and procedures.
* Results orientation, exceptional energy, and ambition to drive systems, technology and process changes across geographies.
* Demonstrated experience of influencing decisions at senior leadership level. Strong stakeholder engagement skills and ability to work with cross cultural teams.
* Possesses skill to leverage interpersonal abilities to influence others and skilfully build credibility with stakeholders.
* Experience of working in a global organisation in a matrix environment.

Resource Solutions Limited, trading as Robert Walters, acts as an employment business and agency, partnering with top organisations to help them find the best talent. We welcome applications from all candidates and are committed to providing equal opportunities.
 



  





 Client promotes collaboration and aims to provide a supportive and inclusive environment where all individuals can maximize their full potential.

title: Project Planner
description:
**Shape the Future of Global Industrial Projects as a Project Planner, PMO**
 Are you ready for the next step in your career? Join us as a Project Planner, PMO and play a key role in supporting complex industrial projects across the Asia Pacific region. Based in Chennai, you will work closely with project managers, site teams, subcontractors, and stakeholders to ensure projects stay on track from engineering and procurement through construction and commissioning.
   

  

 You will be at the center of project execution, transforming schedules into actionable plans, identifying risks early, and helping teams deliver successful outcomes. This is an opportunity to build expertise in global project management while contributing directly to business performance through effective planning and progress control.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* You will develop, maintain, and optimize project schedules in Safran Project or MS Project using standardized PEC templates and Valmet WBS structures.
* You will produce and manage baseline schedules, resource plans, manpower histograms, S\-curves, Earned Value reporting, and progress forecasts to provide clear project visibility.
* You will facilitate planning workshops and collaborate with project teams, discipline leads, site teams, subcontractors, and project managers to gather schedule inputs and align project objectives.
* You will monitor project progress, analyze critical paths, detect delays early, and prepare recovery or mitigation plans to keep projects on track.
* You will support project reviews, change management, claim management, risk and opportunity processes, and sales\-phase scheduling activities while communicating schedule status to internal and customer stakeholders.


**Expectations for you**
* You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in project planning, scheduling, or project controls within industrial EPC or capital investment projects. Experience across both Engineering \& Procurement and Construction \& Commissioning phases is an advantage.
* You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or another relevant technical field.
* You have hands\-on experience with professional CPM scheduling tools. Experience with Safran Project is a strong advantage, and strong Excel skills are required. Knowledge of Power BI is beneficial.
* You have customer\-facing experience and strong communication skills for leading workshops, project reviews, and stakeholder discussions.
* You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
* Some travel is included in this role, although travel requirements are expected to be limited.


**To succeed in this role**
 Success in this role requires strong expertise in project scheduling, progress monitoring, and schedule analysis within complex industrial projects. You combine a solid understanding of the full project lifecycle with the ability to work accurately at a detailed activity level. You are able to manage multiple priorities independently, communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders, and proactively identify risks and opportunities that support successful project delivery.
   

  

 We Also Expect You To Align With Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical Behaviors That Guide How We Lead, Collaborate, And Succeed Together

title: Credit Manager-Wholesale Banking
description:
**Job Requirements**
 About the Role
   

  

**Credit Manager – Wholesale Banking** 
 will manage a sizable portfolio of corporate clients, ensuring portfolio health, and minimizing stress accounts or NPAs. The role holder will be responsible for enhancing the breadth and depth of product offerings to maintain a competitive edge in target markets. A key focus will be on effective account relationship management to optimize customer satisfaction, retention, and wallet share by offering comprehensive banking solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve credit risk management strategies, frameworks, and risk tolerance levels for the corporate lending business.
* Conduct thorough and independent credit risk assessments of all proposals, focusing on asset quality, pricing, collateral, financials, management quality, and industry outlook.
* Provide recommendations on credit ratings and risk\-return ratios to the appropriate approval committees.
* Engage extensively with business teams to ensure alignment with the bank’s risk appetite and identify early warning signs of stress.
* Continuously review client rating models, financial performance, and external ratings to ensure portfolio quality and regulatory compliance.
* Lead portfolio reviews and assess early warning signal effectiveness to minimize risk.
* Ensure timely generation, dissemination, and follow\-up of portfolio risk reports and dashboards in line with defined procedures and quality standards.
* Oversee the implementation of enterprise risk management policies and ensure compliance with all regulatory and internal requirements.
* Periodically review bank products and processes, providing risk mitigation controls and training to business teams.


 Secondary Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide inputs to policy and product teams based on industry changes and trends.
* Support the formulation and revision of credit policies.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to enhance risk governance and operational efficiency.


 What We Are Looking For
   

  

 Education
   

  

* Graduation: Any Graduate
* Post\-Graduation: Any Post Graduate


**Experience**
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in credit risk management, preferably in wholesale or corporate banking.


 Skills and Attributes
   

  

* Strong analytical and decision\-making skills.
* In\-depth understanding of credit risk assessment, financial analysis, and regulatory frameworks.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Proven leadership and team mentoring capabilities.
* Ability to drive innovation and continuous improvement in risk processes.
* High level of integrity, compliance orientation, and customer\-centric mindset.

title: Senior Analyst (Data Strategy & Acquisition)
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

**Senior Analyst (Data Strategy \& Acquisition)**
**Roche India \- Roche Services and Solutions**
**Hyderabad / Chennai**
 A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
   

  

 That’s what makes us Roche.
   

  

 Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics \& technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 In this role, you will have the opportunity to build deep expertise in the external healthcare data ecosystem and contribute to decisions that shape how Roche uses data to support commercial and strategic business needs in the U.S. market.
   

  

 You will be exposed to a broad range of U.S. healthcare and pharmaceutical data sources, including payer, market access, sales, claims, alerts, field, competitive intelligence, and market intelligence datasets. You will learn how these datasets are created, how they differ from one another, where they are strong, where they have limitations, and how they can be applied to real business questions.
   

  

 You will work closely with U.S. stakeholders, external data vendors, and cross\-functional Roche teams. The role provides a strong platform to develop skills in data strategy, vendor evaluation, stakeholder consultation, business problem\-solving, and structured communication.
   

  

 This opportunity is well suited for candidates with a life sciences, pharma, healthcare analytics, consulting, market research, business research, or commercial analytics background who are interested in moving into a broader data strategy and acquisition role. The role will allow you to develop the ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, assess business fit, and support informed data\-related decisions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Support the evaluation, acquisition, and ongoing management of external healthcare and commercial data sources used by Roche U.S. business teams
* Work with U.S. stakeholders to understand business needs, clarify use cases, and translate business questions into data requirements or evaluation criteria
* Evaluate new and existing datasets and vendors based on business relevance, data coverage, methodology, usability, quality, limitations, and fit\-for\-purpose application
* Support the assessment and maintenance of payer intelligence datasets, including sources such as MMIT and DRG Fingertip, to address commercial and market access business needs
* Support the evaluation of sales, claims, alert\-based, field, competitive intelligence, and market intelligence datasets from vendors such as IQVIA, Komodo Health, Evaluate, Citeline, Spherix Global Insights, Dedham Group, NCCN, and similar healthcare data sources
* Partner with external data vendors to understand source methodologies, resolve data\-related questions, clarify deliverables, and support timely access to high\-quality datasets
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to onboard datasets, document business requirements, track evaluation findings, and support decision\-making around data investments
* Apply structured thinking to assess whether a dataset can answer the intended business question, identify potential gaps or risks, and recommend practical next steps
* Challenge assumptions and provide constructive pushback when data sources, methodologies, or stakeholder requests may not align with the intended business objective
* Perform basic data review, profiling, validation, or exploratory analysis when needed to investigate data issues, compare data sources, or support dataset evaluation
* Develop and maintain documentation, including dataset summaries, evaluation notes, vendor comparisons, business requirements, standard operating procedures, and knowledge\-sharing materials
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying ways to make data evaluation, acquisition, documentation, and stakeholder engagement processes more efficient and consistent


**Who You Are**
* You holds a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Healthcare, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline and 5\+ years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, life sciences consulting, healthcare analytics, market research, competitive intelligence, business research, commercial analytics, or related domain
* You bring a strong foundation in life sciences, pharma, healthcare, or a related field, with the ability to understand business questions and connect them to appropriate data sources, methodologies, and decision\-making needs
* You demonstrate structured thinking, sound reasoning, and the ability to engage with stakeholders in a consultative manner. You are able to assess information objectively, ask relevant questions, identify gaps or risks, and communicate findings clearly
* You are comfortable working in a cross\-functional environment with U.S. stakeholders and external vendors, and you are motivated to build expertise in healthcare data strategy, external data evaluation, and commercial data acquisition
* Strong understanding of life sciences, pharma, healthcare, or the broader pharmaceutical industry is required
* Understanding of the pharmaceutical industry, healthcare ecosystem, drug development process, commercial landscape, or market access environment is strongly preferred
* Prior exposure to U.S. healthcare, pharmaceutical commercial data, payer data, claims data, sales data, field data, alerts, market intelligence, or competitive intelligence is an advantage
* Experience working in consulting, business research, market research, analytics, or cross\-functional project environments would be valuable


**Skills \& Capabilities**
**Must have:**
* Strong foundation in biology, life sciences, pharma, healthcare, or the pharmaceutical industry
* Ability to understand business questions and translate them into clear data needs, evaluation criteria, or actionable next steps
* Strong analytical reasoning and problem\-solving skills, with attention to detail
* Ability to ask strategic questions, challenge assumptions, and provide constructive pushback where appropriate
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, especially while working with U.S. business stakeholders
* Ability to collaborate effectively across time zones with U.S.\-based teams
* Strong documentation and organizational skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while working both independently and collaboratively


**Preferred / Good\-to\-Have:**
* Exposure to external healthcare data vendors or platforms such as MMIT, DRG Fingertip, IQVIA, Komodo Health, Evaluate, Citeline, Spherix Global Insights, Dedham Group, NCCN, or similar sources
* Familiarity with payer intelligence, sales, claims, real\-world data, field intelligence, market access, competitive intelligence, or market intelligence datasets
* Basic understanding of data quality concepts, dataset profiling, data validation, or data comparison
* Familiarity with SQL or willingness to learn SQL for basic data extraction, validation, and investigation
* Exposure to visualization or reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Amazon QuickSight, or similar platforms
* Ability to synthesize complex information into clear summaries, recommendations, and “so what?” insights for stakeholders


**Mindset:**
* Consultative and structured in approach
* Curious about the healthcare and pharmaceutical data ecosystem
* Comfortable working across business, data, vendor, and stakeholder discussions
* Able to understand the “why” behind stakeholder requests
* Proactive in identifying risks, gaps, and opportunities for improvement
* Open to learning new data sources, methodologies, tools, and business areas
* Comfortable working with evolving priorities in a U.S. stakeholder\-facing environment


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.

description:
The Regulatory Risk Officer is responsible for driving customer remediation analytics to completion including execution and validation. This position will be part of the USCC Centralized Customer Remediation Team (CCRT). The objective of the USCC CCRT is to quickly assess and identify customer impacts and ensure remediation is completed promptly with the appropriate detailed documentation required by Internal Audit and the Regulators. These activities will be conducted in close partnership with the Issue Owners and Managers within U.S. Consumer Cards. Excellent communication skills are required to negotiate internally, often at a senior level. Highly developed communication and diplomacy skills are required, to guide, influence, and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers. This role is for an individual contributor SME.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Subject matter expert related to data analytics and remediation methodology. May train, mentor, and coach lower\-level staff,
* Owns, designs, and manages client remediation population and impact analyses for USCC owned and impacted issues, including those that are Regulatory.
* 
* Provide expertise and guidance related to the USCC remediation processes and policies, partners with other department leaders to define, prioritize, and execute remediation programs.
* Create comprehensive documentation that conforms to Internal Audit and Regulatory expectations.
* Provide thought leadership and effective challenge throughout the data remediation lifecycle (including root cause analysis, remediation planning, code review for queries related to population completeness planning and execution criteria, and post remediation implementation).
* Challenge preconceived notions about data to ensure no stone is left unturned to identify complete universe of impacted customers is uncovered.
* Cultivate and support a sustainable and repeatable control environment by continuing to improve identified opportunities.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.


**Recommended Qualifications:**
* 12\+ years relevant experience

* Expert knowledge of programming languages (e.g., SAS/SQL, Python and/or R).

title: Supply Chain Performance Specialist
description:
**Vestas has a prominent position in wind technology and a Defining\-force in the development of the wind power industry. Vestas' core business comprises of Development, Manufacturing, Sales, Marketing and Service of Wind Turbines. Come and Join us at Vestas!**
**Technology \& Operations \> Supply Chain \> Performance Management**
 The SIOP Performance Management team improves operational performance and execution excellence across the Service Supply Chain. Acting as a bridge between Planning, Commercial, Logistics, Procurement, and Service functions, the team ensures alignment on business priorities and enables effective end\-to\-end execution.
   

  

 The department oversees performance management, Sales \& Operations Execution (S\&OE), data governance, process improvement, automation, and business intelligence. By combining cross\-functional collaboration with data\-driven insights, the team supports revenue enablement, service availability, and continuous improvement across the global Service organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Improve supply chain performance through effective master data governance, process optimization, and automation initiatives
* Analyze master data structures and business rules to identify opportunities for improved planning accuracy, inventory optimization, and service performance
* Partner with Supply Chain, Planning, Procurement, and Operations stakeholders to ensure data supports business objectives
* Perform root cause analysis and corrective actions for supply chain performance issues linked to data, processes, or system setup
* Define and implement scalable solutions that reduce manual effort and improve process efficiency
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by leveraging digital tools, automation, and data\-driven decision making
* Govern key master data domains and ensure data quality standards across global supply chain processes
* Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize supply chain processes across regions and functions


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field
* 5\+ years of experience within Supply Chain, Planning, Operations, Master Data, or Performance Management
* Good understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain processes and their interaction with planning, inventory, and service performance
* Experience working in a global business environment
* History of improving processes and business results through data\-driven insights
* Experience working with ERP systems, SAP S/4HANA


**Competencies**
* Deep knowledge of master data management and its effect on supply chain performance
* Experience working with SAP master data objects and supply chain\-relevant data structures, including Material, Location, Vendor, and Customer Master Data
* Advanced Excel skills and experience using digital tools for business analysis
* Understanding of inventory management, planning concepts, and supply chain optimization
* Experience with automation tools, reporting solutions, or process digitization initiatives
* Ability to connect business requirements with system and data solutions
* Strategic mindset with the ability to connect operational details to business outcomes
* Effective stakeholder management and collaboration skills
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain complex topics in a simple manner
* Curious and improvement\-oriented approach
* Highly organized approach marked by initiative and follow\-through
* Comfortable questioning established processes and helping bring about change
* Able to navigate ambiguity and work across organizational boundaries


**What We Offer**
 Our company offers an engaging position with great opportunities to grow both professionally and personally in an inspiring workplace at a top producer of wind turbines worldwide. We highly value initiative, responsibility and the right balance between creativity and quality in all solutions. You will become part of a highly professional environment with a deep business commitment.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Your primary location will be in Chennai, India
   

  

 Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 30th Sep 2026
   

  

 Learn more about Vestas at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels
   

  

**Our commitment to a fair hiring.**
 At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.
   

  

**DEIB Statement**
 At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.
   

  

**BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
 It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our\-recruitment\-process
   

  

**About Vestas**
 Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.
   

  

 Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40\+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.
   

  

 With 39,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.
   

  

 Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.

title: Manager - Accounting & External Reporting
description:
**Job Description**
**Why This Role Matters**
 This role sits at the
 **heart of the company's financial governance framework** 
 . The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring that business performance is
 **reported accurately** 
 , risks are
 **identified early** 
 , controls are
 **robust** 
 , and external reporting standards are upheld with the
 **highest level of discipline** 
 .
   

  

 The role requires a finance leader who can combine:
   

  

* Strong technical accounting depth
* Business understanding
* Governance mindset
* Stakeholder influence
* People leadership
* Ability to operate in a complex multinational environment


 This is
 **not a transactional accounting role** 
 . It is a
 **senior controllership role** 
 with high visibility, strong stakeholder engagement, and significant ownership of financial reporting quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead Accounting, Controllership \& Financial Governance
* Own and drive the accounting and controllership agenda for the business.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial books and reported numbers.
* Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes with strong governance and discipline.
* Review and approve complex accounting entries, provisions, accruals, reconciliations, and judgment\-based accounting matters.
* Ensure early identification and resolution of accounting, reporting, or control risks through robust Balance Sheet reviews
* Drive a strong "no surprises" controllership culture across the finance ecosystem.
* Own External Reporting \& Statutory Financial Statements
* Lead preparation and review of statutory financial statements in line with applicable accounting standards.
* Ensure compliance with Ind AS / IFRS / USGAAP and relevant regulatory requirements.
* Own notes to accounts, disclosures, schedules, reporting packs, and management representation requirements.
* Partner with external auditors to ensure smooth statutory audits, limited reviews, and annual reporting cycles.
* Ensure high\-quality, audit\-ready documentation and strong substantiation of financial positions.
* Act as a Strategic Finance Partner \& Specialist on Accounting Matters
* Partner with business finance and functional teams on accounting implications of business decisions.
* Provide guidance on complex transactions, new business models, commercial arrangements, provisions, revenue recognition, cost accounting, and financial reporting treatment.
* Support leadership with clear interpretation of accounting impacts and financial risks.
* Help business teams understand the downstream reporting and compliance implications of operational decisions.
* Oversee Treasury related operations where required.
* Partner Internal Controls, Risk \& Audit Readiness
* Ensure strong adherence to internal control and SOX/control frameworks.
* Lead control reviews, risk assessments, remediation plans, and governance actions.
* Partner with internal audit, external audit, and control teams to resolve observations.
* Drive accountability across teams for timely closure of audit points and control gaps.
* Strengthen the overall control environment through proactive risk identification.
* Drive Process Excellence \& Finance Transformation
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and strengthen accounting and reporting processes.
* Lead improvement initiatives across close, reconciliations, reporting, audit documentation, and controls.
* Partner with shared services and technology teams to improve process reliability and scalability.
* Support ERP / SAP / S4HANA\-related transitions, reporting enhancements, and digital finance initiatives where applicable.
* Reduce manual dependency and improve quality, speed, and transparency of reporting outputs.
* Lead, Coach \& Build a High\-Performing Team
* Manage and develop a team of finance professionals.
* Set clear priorities, performance expectations, timelines, and ownership standards.
* Build technical capability in accounting, reporting, controls, and audit readiness.
* Coach team members to move from task execution to judgment\-led controllership.
* Create a culture of accountability, precision, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Partner effectively with shared services teams and cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver high\-quality outcomes.


 Ideal Candidate Profile
   

  

**Education**
* Chartered Accountant is mandatory.


**Experience**
* Around 12–15 years of post\-qualification experience.
* Preference: FMCG / Consumer Goods / Manufacturing / Large listed or multinational organizations
* Strong experience in accounting, controllership, external reporting, audit, and financial governance.
* Experience in managing teams is important.
* Prior exposure to large multinational, listed, FMCG, manufacturing, or complex matrix organizations will be preferred.
* Candidates with a combination of accounting/external reporting and finance business partnering experience will be highly relevant.


**Technical Skills Required**
* Strong knowledge of Ind AS / IFRS.
* Deep understanding of financial close, statutory reporting, audit, and accounting governance.
* Strong exposure to balance sheet reviews, provisions, accruals, reconciliations, financial statements, and disclosures.
* Strong control mindset, preferably with SOX/internal controls exposure.
* Ability to interpret complex accounting matters and translate them into business\-friendly guidance.
* ERP exposure, especially SAP / S4HANA, will be an advantage.


**Leadership Capabilities**
 The successful candidate should demonstrate:
   

  

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders.
* High\-quality judgement on accounting and reporting matters.
* Strong people leadership and team development capability.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and competing priorities.
* Sharp attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger business context.
* Ability to simplify complex financial topics for business stakeholders.
* Strong executive presence and communication skills.

**Location**

**Role Overview**

 The role will be responsible for defining the digital product vision, designing best\-in\-class customer journeys, driving Salesforce LOS transformation initiatives, implementing AI\-led customer experiences, and leading cross\-functional teams to deliver business outcomes. The incumbent will act as the single point of ownership for product roadmap execution, governance, compliance adherence, stakeholder management, and delivery excellence across the Vehicle Finance ecosystem.
 



 This is a leadership role requiring strong product management capabilities, deep understanding of vehicle finance processes, experience in Salesforce implementations, and the ability to manage large\-scale transformation programs involving business, technology, operations, credit, risk, compliance, and external partners.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Digital Product \& Customer Experience** 



* Define and own the digital product roadmap, and customer experience for Vehicle Finance products
* Design and continuously enhance customer journeys across sourcing, onboarding, credit underwriting, approval, disbursement, servicing, collections, and renewals
* Drive customer\-centric journey transformation using data\-driven decision making and journey analytics
* Conduct regular competition benchmarking and market scans to identify emerging trends, innovations, and best practices
* Identify opportunities for simplification, digitization, automation, and straight\-through processing
* Champion AI\-led experiences, GenAI use cases, intelligent automation, predictive analytics, and conversational experiences across customer and operational journeys
* Define product success metrics and KPIs including conversion, turnaround time, drop\-offs, customer satisfaction, productivity, and adoption



  





**Product Delivery \& Salesforce Transformation** 



* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of Vehicle Finance digital initiatives on LOS/CRM platforms
* Own product requirements, business cases, feature prioritization, and roadmap execution
* Translate business requirements into scalable product solutions and user stories
* Drive implementation of Vehicle Finance journeys
* Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure high\-quality solution design and implementation
* Manage product releases from conception through production deployment



  





**Team Leadership** 



* Lead and mentor a team of: Product Managers, Business Analysts, Quality Assurance (QA) Teams and Vendor Delivery Teams
* Establish a high\-performance product culture with strong execution discipline
* Drive agile delivery practices and continuous improvement initiatives
* Manage team objectives, development plans, productivity, and performance outcomes



  





**Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as the central coordination point across stakeholders from: Information Technology, Business, Operations, Support, Compliance, Risk, Credit, Analytics and External Vendors
* Drive alignment between business priorities and technology execution
* Influence senior stakeholders and obtain consensus on key decisions
* Present product updates, risks, investment cases, and governance reports to leadership teams



  





**Governance \& Steering Committee Management** 



* Run Steering Committees, Program Governance Forums, Executive Reviews, and Product Councils
* Define and track program objectives, milestones, KPIs, dependencies, and risks
* Establish governance frameworks for monitoring delivery, operational readiness, and business outcomes
* Ensure transparent reporting of project progress, issues, and escalations
* Drive timely resolution of cross\-functional dependencies and blockers



  





**Risk, Compliance \& Audit Management** 



* Own product compliance requirements and regulatory alignment across the product lifecycle
* Ensure adherence to banking, lending, audit, information security, and data privacy standards
* Maintain proper documentation, audit trails, control frameworks, and governance processes
* Track regulatory changes and assess their impact on product journeys
* Drive closure of audit observations, compliance requirements, and control gaps



  





**Program \& Release Management** 



* Identify and mitigate project risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and delivery challenges
* Develop program plans, release schedules, and implementation roadmaps
* Own release governance and go\-live readiness processes
* Oversee SIT, UAT, production validation, and deployment activities
* Ensure timely defect resolution and post\-production stabilization
* Monitor user adoption and business performance after deployment
* Drive continuous optimization and product enhancement initiatives



  





**Transformation \& Innovation** 



* Lead enterprise\-wide transformation initiatives focusing on:
* Process automation
* API\-led integrations
* AI and GenAI solutions
* Digital onboarding enhancements
* Analytics\-driven decisioning
* Cross\-sell and upsell enablement
* Process re\-engineering
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, customer experience, and business productivity.



  





**Functional \& Domain Skills** 



* Deep understanding of Vehicle Finance processes and lending lifecycle.
* Strong expertise in: Vehicle Loans, Auto Finance, Loan Origination Systems (LOS), Credit \& Risk workflows, Lending Operations
* Strong understanding of underwriting journeys, decisioning processes, approval matrices, and compliance requirements



  





**Technical Skills** 



* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce implementations
* Strong understanding of:
* Salesforce objects and data model
* Workflow automation
* APIs and integrations
* Security and user management



  





**Program Management Skills** 



* Proven experience managing large transformation programs and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong project planning, governance, and risk management capabilities.
* Expertise in Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery models.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong execution focus with demonstrated delivery outcomes.



  





**Experience \& Qualification** 




**Mandatory** 



* 7\+ years of overall experience in Product Management, Digital Transformation, or Program Management
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience in Vehicle Finance / Auto Finance domain
* Proven experience delivering Salesforce\-based LOS/CRM transformations
* Experience managing large cross\-functional and vendor teams
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Technology, Business Administration, or related discipline



**Preferred** 



* MBA from a reputed institution
* Salesforce LOS / CRM transformation programs
* Exposure to AI/GenAI\-powered transformation initiatives
* Vendor management and SI engagement



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




 A strategic product leader with deep Vehicle Finance domain expertise, strong Salesforce implementation experience, and a proven track record of leading large\-scale digital transformation programs. The candidate should be equally comfortable defining customer experience, managing executive stakeholders, leading delivery teams, and driving measurable business impact through technology and innovation.

title: FS-RC-FSRM - CSTC-FA and R-Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Staff**
**Description**
 EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry\-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker\-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process \& controls.
   

  

 Within EY’s Risk Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset\-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As part of the financial analysis of the bank’s exposures to a diverse range of public, semi‑public, and private counterparties \- including local authorities and their affiliates, public institutions, sovereigns, public financial institutions, SPVs, corporates, PPP/concession companies, and sponsors \- analysts will support credit‑risk assessments and contribute to internal‑rating activities across France and key international markets (primarily France, Italy, Spain, the UK, and, to a lesser extent, the US).
   

  

**Core Responsibilities:**
* Support the collection, quality review, and analysis of financial statements and key risk data for relevant counterparties.
* Assist in the preparation, structuring, and validation of input files and data flows used in rating processes and engines.
* Contribute to the drafting of financial analysis reports / credit memos, including key drivers, risks/mitigants, and preliminary views on ratings/outlooks, under supervision.
* Perform controls and reconciliations to ensure data quality, completeness, and consistency prior to processing.
* For French public sector entities, support data preprocessing and preparation of inputs for mass processing in the rating engine (as applicable).
* Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to support day\-to\-day operations and contribute to process improvements and documentation updates.
* Build, review, and validate financial models with strong command of Excel;
* Analyze large datasets and generate comparative insights (experience with Power BI/SQL is an advantage).


**Domain Skills Required:**
* Conduct in‑depth financial analysis, including detailed review of public‑sector and corporate financial statements (IFRS/French GAAP), ratio assessments (leverage, coverage, liquidity), evaluation of working capital requirements, and comprehensive cash‑flow analysis.
* Apply project‑finance principles to assess SPV cash‑flow structures, DSCR/LLCR metrics, debt‑sizing considerations, covenant frameworks, reserve mechanisms, security packages, and risk‑allocation structures across concession and PPP projects.
* Evaluate sovereign and quasi‑sovereign credit risk by analyzing institutional frameworks, governance quality, policy stability, and levels of explicit or implicit government support.
* Perform corporate and sectoral assessments by analyzing business models, industry dynamics, competitive positioning (utilities, transportation, energy, social infrastructure), and conducting sensitivity and benchmarking analyses across markets.
* Review and interpret financing documentation, including term sheets, loan documentation, covenant packages, guarantees, and where applicable key provisions within bond indentures.
* Prepare clear, structured, and analytically sound credit memoranda, including rating recommendations, risk/mitigation assessments, and identification of early‑warning indicators.
* Support and conduct gap assessments, impact analyses, and business‑readiness evaluations related to regulatory change initiatives.
* Demonstrate strong technical expertise and up‑to‑date industry knowledge across financial products, market practices, and risk methodologies.
* Lead key workstreams within large‑scale client engagements or independently manage smaller engagements, ensuring consistent delivery of high‑quality outcomes.
* Review outputs prepared by team members to ensure analytical quality, completeness, and adherence to internal standards.
* Stay informed of emerging trends, regulatory changes, and sector‑specific developments to anticipate client needs and strengthen advisory delivery.
* Monitor project progress, proactively manage risks, and communicate priorities, challenges, and updates effectively to stakeholders.
* Mentor and guide junior consultants, fostering skill development, knowledge sharing, and professional growth within the team.


**Qualifications, Certifications And Education**
**Must\-have:**
* Master’s degree in Business Administration (Finance/Economics) or CA qualification, with 1\-4 years of relevant experience in financial analysis or risk‑related roles.
* Foundational experience (internship/apprenticeship/junior role) in financial analysis, credit risk, audit, or corporate finance.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, core credit risk principles, and familiarity with project finance, corporate, or sovereign risk concepts.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, with foundational knowledge of Power BI and/or SQL considered a plus.
* Working knowledge of Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance, and Financial Reporting frameworks.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business and technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.
* Demonstrated automation and innovation mindset, with willingness to improve processes and tools.
* Strong command of written and spoken professional English.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly.


**Good\-to\-have:**
* Professional certifications such as FRM, CFA, or PRM.
* Regulatory exposure or experience in areas such as Credit Underwriting, Basel frameworks, and CCAR.
* Familiarity with risk‑management systems, tools, or platforms.
* Willingness to travel based on client or project requirements.
* Previous project management experience
* Proficiency in French is highly advantageous and may be required for certain engagements.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
