title: Senior SAP Consultant - COPA (Profitability Analysis)
description:
Join NKT’s SAP Digital Core team to shape how profitability is measured across markets, customers, products, and projects. As Senior SAP Consultant – CO PA (Profitability Analysis), you will design, configure, and optimize account\-based CO‑PA and S/4HANA Margin Analysis (ACDOCA) to deliver accurate, timely contribution margin insights that enable smarter pricing, product mix, and strategic decisions. This is an opportunity to grow within a global, product\-focused leader advancing the green transition, gaining deep exposure to IS‑Mill, Universal Journal, and end\-to\-end FI/CO integration—while collaborating with experienced colleagues across Europe in a supportive, learning\-centered environment. Do you want to build an SAP platform that accelerates NKT’s growth journey?
   

  

**Design and optimize CO‑PA in S/4HANA**
 In this role, you will translate complex finance and business requirements into robust CO‑PA and Margin Analysis designs, ensuring harmonized revenue, cost, and margin views for decision\-making. You will own operating concern structures, characteristics and value fields, derivation strategies, valuation logic, allocations, and settlement designs, while integrating with SD, MM, PP, and FI. You will safeguard closing processes, incident/problem resolution, and partner with BI/Analytics on data extraction and reporting models (e.g., BW/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud). You will manage enhancements and change requests from impact assessment through deployment, supported by comprehensive documentation, testing strategies, and governance.
   

  

* Your responsibility will be to:
* Design and configure operating concerns, characteristics, value fields, derivations, valuation, and settlements.
* Optimize account‑based CO‑PA and Margin Analysis (ACDOCA) with revenue recognition and cost flows.
* Define consistent profitability dimensions across customer, product, region, project, and contract.
* Manage allocations/assessments, top‑down distributions, and overhead costing transparency.
* Ensure stable month‑/year‑end CO‑PA closes, reconciliations with FI, and performance in reporting.


 Based in G3C Chennai within Group IT, reporting to the Senior Manager – IT. You will collaborate closely with FICO, BI/Analytics, architects, and global process owners across Europe. International travel for trainings may be required.
   

  

**Consultant Who Thrives On Global Collaboration**
 You are a curious, outcome‑oriented professional who enjoys turning financial and operational data into clear, business‑ready insights. You communicate complex CO‑PA concepts in simple terms and build trust with finance, business stakeholders, and IT partners. You lead tasks, work in distributed, multicultural teams, and manage multiple priorities with a structured, documentation‑first approach. A continuous‑improvement mindset helps you respectfully propose better profitability analytics, and follow through to implementation—always considering accessibility and the needs of people with different backgrounds, including persons with disabilities.
   

  

**You Also Have**
* 8\+ years SAP CO‑PA/Controlling experience, incl. S/4HANA account‑based CO‑PA/Margin Analysis.
* Designed and configured operating concerns, characteristics, value fields, derivations, valuation, settlements.
* Robust integration with SD billing, MM movements, PP orders, FI postings, and overhead accounting (cost centers, internal orders, WBS).
* Month‑/year‑end CO/CO‑PA close experience with FI reconciliations, variance analysis, and management reporting.
* Deep understanding of S/4HANA Universal Journal (ACDOCA) and implications for Margin Analysis and reporting.
* Familiarity with BW/4HANA or SAP Analytics Cloud for CO‑PA data consumption.


**Grow NKT’s Digital Core With S/4HANA Skills**
 NKT is committed to developing a diverse organization and culture where people of diverse backgrounds can grow and are inspired to do their best. We are establishing gender diversity at NKT and encouraging all interested candidates to apply – even if you don’t tick all the boxes described. We believe that a diverse organization enables long\-term performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture creates a better work environment.
   

  

 At NKT, you will join a collaborative, international team with clear pathways for career development. You will deepen your skills across S/4HANA, IS‑Mill, Universal Journal, and end‑to‑end profitability analytics while contributing to an SAP platform that supports NKT’s growth and the green energy transition. Expect transparent leadership, knowledge sharing with European colleagues, practical learning, and opportunities to travel for knowledge transfer.
   

  

 Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!
   

  

 We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than
 **30th of September 2026** 
 . Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e\-mail.
   

  

 We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.
   

  

 Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!
   

  

**About NKT**
*NKT connects a greener world with high\-quality power cable technology and takes centre stage as the world moves towards green energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low\-, medium\- and high\-voltage power cable solutions enabling sustainable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology building the infrastructure for the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today. Beyond reporting, you will help transform how Finance operates by driving automation, process standardization, and the adoption of AI\-enabled solutions that improve reporting efficiency, analytical capability, and decision\-making.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a builder who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys creating scalable processes, and has experience leading reporting, shared services, or center\-of\-excellence organizations that support global stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones.

* Establish operating procedures, governance standards, documentation, and controls that ensure reporting consistency, accuracy, and scalability.

* Documented standards and controls enable the function to scale efficiently.

**Required Qualifications**

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Job Description \- Strategy \& Transactions – Strategy (Senior Consultant)**
 At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth.
   

  

 We work with C\-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most — from navigating complex M\&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high\-stakes moments.
   

  

 But we don’t stop at client impact — we are equally passionate about investing in our people. At S\&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.
   

  

 Our capabilities span the full lifecycle of transformation — from Enterprise and Growth Strategy to Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy, end\-to\-end M\&A, valuation and modeling, and performance improvement \& restructuring, to infrastructure \& real estate advisory and sustainability\-driven innovation.
   

  

 If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact — and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ — Strategy \& Transactions is your next move.
   

  

**The team**
 Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate \& Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy \& Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation.
   

  

 Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.
   

  

**Work you will do**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, channel strategies, and pricing strategies.
   

  

* Identify strategies for growth and value creation
* Develop the appropriate business models, operating models, and capabilities to support their strategic vision
* Providing service excellence by identifying key client business issues, determining client needs by supplementing the standard assessment techniques and tools with innovative approaches, evaluating, and validating analysis and developing recommendations for the client in the context of the overall engagement
* Contribute to multiple work\-threads of large, complex engagements, with the high\-quality deliverables
* Participate in the development and presentation of proposals for business development activities
* Maximize the ROI on technology investments and leverage technology trends to architect future business strategies


**Required Experience And Skills**
**Strategy\-specific experience:**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (TMT \- Technology, Media, Telecommunications )**
* Understanding of value chain, key business capabilities, processes, and user journeys enabling organizations in one or more of TMT sectors (Technology, Telecommunications, Media \& Entertainment) in B2B and / or B2C domains

* Ability to develop business requirements and translate them into technical requirements.

* One life cycle project execution experience in defining and/or implementing technology strategy, target\-state solutions, and roadmap for improving business outcomes.
* Candidates with project experience on either one or more of the following areas:
* IT Strategy \& Alignment – Delivering IT Strategy, driven both from a top\-down analysis starting with an articulated business strategy and a bottom\-up technology capability analysis; Experience working on IT cost reduction techniques, portfolio modernization and delivery roadmap creation within TMT.
* Technology Operating Model Design \- Assessment of current state operating model, ability to identify pain points and process gaps; design of target state operating model and associated roadmap for TMT companies.
* Enterprise Architecture – Experience of Enterprise Architecture capabilities such as Blueprinting, solution architecture, architecture assessment, planning and cost estimation. Knowledge of any of the major Enterprise Architecture Frameworks (preferred) E.g., TOGAF, FEA(F), and DoDAF
* IT Outsourcing \- Experience working on IT Outsourcing model, vendor analysis and benchmarking, contract analysis and understanding of how IT resources create shareholder (business) value.
* Cloud Strategy – Understand the impact of cloud computing in business and technology decisions, ability to identify and articulate the business and technology drivers of cloud computing within TMT, design of business cases for cloud. Certifications such as AWS, GCP, Azure will be a plus. Experience with workload assessment, business cases development, operational assessment, roadmap creation, vendor selection.
* AI (GenAI, Agentic AI) – Knowledge and experience in AI and GenAI concepts, landscape (E.g., OpenAI, Microsoft Azure Cognitive Services, NVIDIA AI Foundations, GPT3 etc.) use cases and ability to assess AI use case fitment based on client demands. Understanding of the application of latest trends such as Agentic AI to TMT companies. Ability to quantify AI value for organizations and create AI business/value case along with an AI adoption roadmap.
* Technology Program Management – Understanding of IT program and project management principles, techniques and tools, including Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, Site Reliability Engineering. Experience on tools such as JIRA, Miro / Lucidchart, SQL is desirable but not mandatory.
* Preferred experience of engaging in strategic issues for senior\-level clients including C\-Suite executives
* Exposure to working in non\-India geographies (preferably US) and / or interacting with global stakeholders.


**Core Consulting Skills**
* Clear and concise communication \- Conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.
* Good client presence – Interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.
* Analytical thinking \- Ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring \- structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems.
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused \- Develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources.
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate.
* Network \- Ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.
* AI and analytics tooling \- Ability to use AI tools for professional\-level research and consulting artifacts creation; Exposure to basic automation for productivity using these tools is a good to have; Ability to use analytics tools such as Tableau, PowerBI and basic awareness of SQL


**\#FY27ReferralCampaign**

* MBA or MS from a premier (Tier\-1\) school in India or abroad
* 4 to 5 years of relevant experience (post MS / MBA) in TMT


**Preferred:**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering

 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Job Description \- Strategy \& Transactions – Strategy (Sr. Consultant)** 
**At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth.** 
**We work with C\-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most — from navigating complex M\&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high\-stakes moments.** 
**But we don’t stop at client impact — we are equally passionate about investing in our people. At S\&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.** 
**Our capabilities span the full lifecycle of transformation —from Enterprise and Growth Strategy to Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy, end\-to\-end M\&A, valuation and modeling, and performance improvement \& restructuring, to infrastructure \& real estate advisory and sustainability\-driven innovation.** 
**If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact — and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ — Strategy \& Transactions is your next move.** 
**The team**
 Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate \& Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy \& Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation.
   

  

 Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.
   

  

**Work you will do:**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, channel strategies, and pricing strategies.
   

  

* Identify strategies for growth and value creation
* Develop the appropriate business models, technology operating models, and capabilities to support their strategic vision
* Maximize the ROI on technology investments and leverage technology trends to architect future technology strategies


**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (Consumer)**
* Following experience would be required: Experience in one or more subsectors, including Retail, Consumer Products, Airlines, Hotels, Restaurants, and/or Automotives
* Candidates are required to have at least one full project experience on either one or more of the following areas:
* Technology Strategy \& Alignment – Delivering Technology Strategy, driven both from a top\-down analysis starting with an articulated business strategy and a bottom\-up technology capability analysis; Experience working on cost reduction techniques, portfolio modernization and delivery roadmap creation within Consumer Industry
* Cloud Strategy – Understand the impact of cloud computing through hybrid cloud, data centers, cloud strategy in business and technology decisions, ability to identify and articulate the business and technology drivers of cloud computing across industries, design of business cases for cloud. Certifications such as AWS, GCP, Azure will be a plus. Experience with workload assessment, business cases development, operational assessment, roadmap creation, vendor selection for companies in Consumer space
* Technology Operating Model Design \- Assessment of current state operating model, ability to identify pain points and process gaps; design of target state operating model and associated roadmap for leading companies in Consumer Industry
* Enterprise Architecture – Experience of Enterprise Architecture capabilities such as Blueprinting, solution architecture, architecture assessment, planning and cost estimation. Knowledge of any of the major Enterprise Architecture Frameworks (preferred) E.g., TOGAF, FEA(F), and DoDAF.
* Technology Outsourcing \- Experience working on Technology Outsourcing model, vendor analysis and benchmarking, contract analysis and understanding of how IT resources create shareholder (business) value within Consumer Industry
* AI/ML – Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and frameworks, ability to design solutions around automation including advanced AI / ML solutions in areas of deep learning, machine learning, NLP, Simulation etc.; knowledge of AI/ML implementation use cases within Consumer Industry
* GenAI – Knowledge and experience in GenAI concepts, landscape (E.g., OpenAI, Microsoft Azure Cognitive Services, NVIDIA AI Foundations, GPT3 etc.) use cases across relevant industries and ability to assess GenAI fitment based on client demands within Consumer Industry
* DevOps / Agile – Strong understanding of Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, Site Reliability Engineering with hands on experience on tools such as Jenkins, Git and JIRA
* Strong understanding of front\-to\-back architecture principles, technology stack, infrastructure with exposure to new age tools
* One life cycle project execution experience in recommending and/or implementing Technology strategy and solutions for improving business outcomes
* Ability to articulate leading business issues and trends including the associated technology implications within Consumer Industry
* Demonstrate application of business acumen while leveraging information technology
* Exposure to working in non\-India Geographies (preferably the US) and / or interacting with Global stakeholders


**Core Consulting**
* Communication: Ability to conduct client interviews, facilitate workshops and training sessions, and present findings and recommendations clearly and concisely
* Client Presence: Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients and cross\-functional team members
* Analytical Thinking: Proficiency in quantitative analysis, primary and secondary research, and business case development; ability to synthesize data into actionable insights and recommendations. Strong command of analytical and productivity tools including Microsoft Excel (financial modeling, data analysis) and PowerPoint (storyboarding, executive\-level presentations) is a plus
* Structured Problem Solving: Logical, hypothesis\-driven approach to problem solving with demonstrated ability to perform root cause analysis
* Delivery Excellence: Deadline\-oriented and quality\-focused; capable of owning end\-to\-end delivery of high\-quality work products, managing workstreams, developing engagement plans, and mentoring junior team members
* Collaboration: Comfortable working independently and within teams across all levels; able to prioritize effectively, manage scope changes, handle multiple assignments simultaneously, and escalate issues proactively
* Networking: Self\-starter with the ability to navigate career growth and build a strong internal and external professional network

description:
**Position Overview**
 We are looking for a detail\-oriented and analytical Business Financial Analyst to support our Engineered Plastics business. The role will focus on delivering high\-quality financial analysis, supporting pricing decisions, and partnering with commercial teams to improve business performance. The ideal candidate should have strong financial modeling skills, a good understanding of revenue drivers, and the ability to convert data into actionable insights.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own and deliver financial reporting and analysis for assigned business segments
* Analyze revenue, pricing, and profitability (price / volume / mix)
* Perform variance analysis and explain key performance drivers
* Build, maintain, and improve financial models
* Support pricing decisions through margin and profitability insights
* Partner with commercial and operational teams to gather inputs and validate assumptions
* Identify risks and opportunities impacting financial results
* Improve reporting processes, tools, and data quality
* Translate business inputs into structured financial insights for decision\-making


**Core Skills**
* Strong understanding of revenue and margin drivers
* Advanced Excel skills (modeling, analysis, dashboards)
* Experience with data analysis and reporting tools (Power BI is a plus)
* Ability to work with large datasets
* Ability to connect financial outcomes with business decisions
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Comfortable working with ambiguous or incomplete data
* Strong communication and stakeholder management
* Proactive mindset with attention to detail


**Additional Information** 
 : This role is based in Chennai (Taramani).The position supports U.K. business hours (approx. 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST) and during month close US business hours (approx. 7:00 PM \-4:00 PM IST)
   

  

**Requirements**
* Education: B.Com, MBA (Finance), CA, or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)
* Experience: 7\+ years of relevant experience in Finance reporting, Analyzing revenue, Pricing \& Profitability
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (formulas and lookups)
